title: AutoVLA-D: Learn a Trajectory-Geometric Condition from Reasoning for Autonomous Driving VLA
abstract: Autoregressive VLA planning usually predicts continuous trajectories as the final output, but driving instructions often describe actions rather than ego states, which weakens direct conditioning on the final continuous trajectory. We address this gap with TrajCond, which introduces a discrete trajectory-geometric condition for VLA planning. Specifically, we represent TrajCond as a 1D-Brohan differential action trajectory and learn it with a two-stage training framework before final continuous trajectory prediction. With the simultaneous autoregressive generation of discrete and numeric trajectories, we name our method AutoVLA-D (Double). Experiments on NAVSIM navtest, nuScenes, and NeuroNCAP show that discrete trajectories are weaker as direct outputs but more effective as TrajCond, consistently improving final continuous trajectory prediction across closed-loop and open-loop driving benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/ShivaTeam/AutoVLA-D.

title_zh: AutoVLA-D：从推理中学习面向自动驾驶 VLA 的轨迹几何条件
abstract_zh: 自回归 VLA 规划通常将连续轨迹作为最终输出进行预测，但驾驶指令往往描述动作而非自车状态，这削弱了对最终连续轨迹的直接条件化。我们通过 TrajCond 弥补这一差距，它为 VLA 规划引入了一种离散的轨迹几何条件。具体而言，我们将 TrajCond 表示为 1D-Brohan 差分动作轨迹，并在最终连续轨迹预测之前，通过两阶段训练框架学习该条件。由于可同时自回归生成离散轨迹和数值轨迹，我们将方法命名为 AutoVLA-D（Double）。在 NAVSIM navtest、nuScenes 和 NeuroNCAP 上的实验表明，离散轨迹作为直接输出时效果较弱，但作为 TrajCond 更有效，能够在闭环和开环驾驶基准上持续改善最终连续轨迹预测。代码见 https://github.com/ShivaTeam/AutoVLA-D。

title: When Credit Turns Against Tools: Transition-Aware Credit Assignment in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards trains language models through multi-turn tool interactions, yet their reasoning performance and tool-calling ability can decline during training. We trace this degradation to three coupled mechanisms: (1) tool-token imbalance produces negative overall tool credit when incorrect trajectories contain more tool tokens per turn than correct ones; (2) aggregation amplification can further strengthen this negative signal as token-mean aggregation gives longer incorrect trajectories greater weight in policy updates; and (3) failure-driven retries prolong trajectories as models tend to call tools again after execution errors, extending potential negative credit to recovery attempts. To counter this suppression, we propose Transition-Aware Credit Assignment (TACA), which targets the transition from reasoning to tool use through supervision of both call initiation and generation. Specifically, TACA uses Advantage Projection to enforce a nonnegative mean advantage on tool-call tokens within each prompt group through a minimal uniform shift. Additionally, TACA guides tool-use decisions with Decision Contrast, comparing rewards for tool-assisted and direct answers to the same prompt. Through Supervised Replay, it reinforces tool-call generation using calls from previously sampled correct trajectories. Across models and tasks, TACA improves performance and sustains more reliable tool interaction during training, raising mean accuracy over MT-GRPO on six reasoning benchmarks by 4.61 percentage points for Qwen2.5-1.5B and 3.61 for Qwen2.5-3B. Our code is available at https://github.com/tmlr-group/TACA.

title_zh: 当信用反噬工具时：智能体强化学习中的过渡感知信用分配
abstract_zh: 带可验证奖励的智能体强化学习通过多轮工具交互训练语言模型，但其推理性能和工具调用能力可能在训练过程中下降。我们将这种退化追溯到三个相互耦合的机制：(1) 工具 token 失衡：当错误轨迹每轮包含的工具 token 多于正确轨迹时，会产生整体为负的工具信用；(2) 聚合放大：由于 token 均值聚合会让较长的错误轨迹在策略更新中占据更大权重，这种负信号会进一步增强；(3) 失败驱动的重试会延长轨迹：模型在执行错误后倾向于再次调用工具，从而将潜在的负信用扩展到恢复尝试上。为抵消这种抑制，我们提出过渡感知信用分配 (TACA)，通过同时监督调用发起和生成，针对从推理到工具使用的过渡进行干预。具体而言，TACA 使用 Advantage Projection，通过最小幅度的均匀平移，使每个 prompt 组内工具调用 token 的平均 advantage 非负。此外，TACA 使用 Decision Contrast 引导工具使用决策，比较同一 prompt 下工具辅助回答与直接回答的奖励。通过 Supervised Replay，它利用先前采样的正确轨迹中的工具调用来强化工具调用生成。在多种模型和任务上，TACA 提升了性能，并在训练期间维持更可靠的工具交互；在六个推理基准上，相较 MT-GRPO，Qwen2.5-1.5B 的平均准确率提升 4.61 个百分点，Qwen2.5-3B 提升 3.61 个百分点。我们的代码见 https://github.com/tmlr-group/TACA。

title: MaxIM: Maximally Informative Incremental Summarization via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: AI systems must often maintain bounded memory of unbounded interaction histories. However, optimizing the memory representation, and its updates, for downstream task utility is difficult for standard reinforcement learning (RL) due to severe credit assignment bottlenecks induced by sparse, delayed rewards. We introduce MaxIM (Maximally Informative Incremental Memory), a framework that formulates incremental summarization as a capacity-constrained, information-theoretic reward-shaping problem. Grounded in value suboptimality bounds, we show that bounding sequential information loss motivates maximizing the predictive log-likelihood of future, task-relevant targets, a variational lower bound on predictive sufficiency. We introduce a recursive consistency condition to ensure summaries are grounded by maximizing mutual information (MI) with the observed history. We mitigate credit assignment issues with a parameterized asymmetric critic that computes step-wise variational MI bounds for dense reward shaping. Empirical evaluation on long-horizon scientific reading and multi-turn dialogue benchmarks shows that MaxIM outperforms RL, supervised fine-tuning, and prompt-focused baselines on factual grounding, comprehensive autorater metrics, and downstream task utility across strict token budgets and extended horizons, without the need for expensive human preference labels.
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

title_zh: MaxIM：通过强化学习实现信息量最大化的增量摘要
abstract_zh: AI 系统常常需要对无界的交互历史维持有界记忆。然而，由于稀疏、延迟奖励引发的严重信用分配瓶颈，标准强化学习 (RL) 很难针对下游任务效用优化记忆表示及其更新。我们提出 MaxIM（Maximally Informative Incremental Memory），一个将增量摘要表述为容量受限的信息论奖励塑形问题的框架。基于价值次优性界，我们表明，约束序列信息损失会促使最大化对未来的任务相关目标的预测对数似然，而后者是预测充分性的一个变分下界。我们引入递归一致性条件，通过最大化与已观测历史的互信息 (MI) 来确保摘要具有依据。我们使用参数化非对称 critic 来缓解信用分配问题，该 critic 计算每步的变分 MI 界，以实现稠密奖励塑形。在长时域科学阅读和多轮对话基准上的实证评估表明，在严格 token 预算和更长时域下，MaxIM 在事实依据、综合 autorater 指标和下游任务效用方面优于 RL、监督微调和以 prompt 为中心的基线，且无需昂贵的人类偏好标签。

title: VLA Adaptation with Real and Simulated Data: A Case Study on Robotic Chess
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are trained as general-purpose foundation models for robot learning, and require fine-tuning for each downstream task and robot. This raises practical questions such as how much data and training updates are needed, how checkpoints should be selected, and whether simulation can be leveraged to alleviate the cost of real data collection. We study these questions on a task that requires both precise manipulation and spatial understanding of the scene. In this task, an SO-101 arm moves a chess king between two squares that are given only by their names, such as e4 and a5. We fine-tune π_0.5 with various dataset sizes and update budgets, using teleoperated demonstrations as well as simulated demonstrations from a randomized scripted expert that imitates the variability of human demonstrations. In simulation, the success rate scales with both data and updates. Importantly, we find that a short learning-rate cool-down adds up to 31 points and is necessary for comparing checkpoints, and that validation loss and action error are unreliable for model selection. On the real arm, we fine-tune on up to 256 teleoperated demonstrations and evaluate ten policies in 25 trials each. Partial results indicate that pretraining on the simulated demonstrations helps substantially, most clearly when real data is scarce. We also present a negative result, in which training on the policy's own rollouts with filtered behavior cloning, RECAP-style advantage conditioning, corrections from an automatic coach, or residual reinforcement learning did not yield a measurable improvement over plain behavior cloning in our setting. We release the simulator, the expert and the real demonstrations.
comment: CoRL 2026 Workshop "Pretrain to Adapt: What Makes a Pretrained Policy Adaptable?". 8 pages main text, 15 pages total, 15 figures, 4 tables

title_zh: 真实与仿真数据下的 VLA 适配：机器人国际象棋案例研究
abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型被训练为用于机器人学习的通用基础模型，并且需要针对每个下游任务和机器人进行微调。这引出了若干实际问题，例如需要多少数据和训练更新、应如何选择检查点，以及能否利用仿真来减轻真实数据采集的成本。我们在一项既需要精确操作又需要场景空间理解的任务上研究这些问题。在该任务中，SO-101 机械臂根据仅以名称给出的两个格子（如 e4 和 a5）移动国际象棋的国王。我们使用遥操作演示，以及来自随机化脚本专家的仿真演示（该专家模仿人类演示的多样性），在不同数据集规模和更新预算下微调 π_0.5。在仿真中，成功率随数据和更新次数的增加而提升。重要的是，我们发现短暂的学习率冷却最多可带来 31 个百分点的提升，并且对于比较检查点是必要的；同时，验证损失和动作误差对于模型选择并不可靠。在真实机械臂上，我们使用最多 256 条遥操作演示进行微调，并以每个策略 25 次试验评估十个策略。部分结果表明，在仿真演示上进行预训练有显著帮助，在真实数据稀缺时尤为明显。我们还给出一个负面结果：在我们的实验设置中，使用过滤式行为克隆、RECAP 风格的 advantage 条件化、来自自动教练的纠正或残差强化学习，在策略自身的 rollout 上训练，均未能相较普通行为克隆带来可测量的提升。我们公开了模拟器、专家演示和真实演示数据。

title: DreamLander: A 6-DOF World Model based Reinforcement Learning Planetary Lander
abstract: Soft powered descent landings are becoming evermore important in the field of space exploration and scientific advancement, because of their ability to deliver mission critical payloads, both highly accurately and safely. The high efficiency restriction on planetary landings due to the severely limited fuel supply results in the need for optimal guidance trajectories and control. Model based reinforcement learning is proving to be an important tool in simplifying the highly complex process of generating optimal guidance trajectories and control. In this work, we present DreamLander, a state of the art model based reinforcement learning algorithm based on DreamerV3, to generate optimal guidance and control for a realistic 6 degree of freedom entry descent landing problem. The model based approach creates a sample efficient and highly generalizable model that can be applied to a variety of scenarios whilst maintaining a high degree of accuracy, landing within 2 meters of the designated landing zone, and with velocity norm less than 0.3 meters per second. DreamLander makes use of state sensor observations, making progress toward End-to-End solutions of the Entry Descent Landing problem.
journal_ref: Nehma, G.M., Quinn, P., Tiwari, M., & Riano-Rios, C. (2026). DreamLander: A 6-DOF World Model Based Reinforcement Learning Planetary Lander. AIAA SCITECH 2026 Forum

title_zh: DreamLander：基于 6-DOF 世界模型的强化学习行星着陆器
abstract_zh: 动力软着陆在太空探索和科学进步领域正变得越来越重要，因为它能够高度精确且安全地投送任务关键载荷。行星着陆因燃料供应严重受限而面临严格的高效率要求，因此需要最优的制导轨迹与控制。基于模型的强化学习正被证明是简化生成最优制导轨迹与控制这一高度复杂过程的重要工具。本文提出 DreamLander，一种基于 DreamerV3 的最先进基于模型的强化学习算法，用于为真实的 6 自由度进入、下降与着陆问题生成最优制导与控制。该基于模型的方法构建出样本高效且高度可泛化的模型，可应用于多种场景，同时保持高精度：在指定着陆区 2 米范围内着陆，且速度范数小于 0.3 米/秒。DreamLander 利用状态传感器观测，推动进入、下降与着陆 (EDL) 问题向端到端解决方案迈进。

title: ScanDreamer: A Map-Grounded World Model for Quadrotor Navigation
abstract: Quadrotors inspecting buildings and tunnels must navigate unknown clutter with a forward-facing depth camera whose limited field of view constrains scene understanding and collision-avoiding navigation. Recent world-model agents learn navigation through imagined experience (e.g., AirDreamer), but remain data-intensive and often lack explicit geometric memory and awareness of what the camera can observe. We propose ScanDreamer, a map-grounded world model that constructs an online 2D scan-memory map from depth images and vehicle pose. Our world model, actor, and critic are conditioned on this map, which also defines a geodesic progress reward. Moreover, a forward-cone penalty discourages horizontal motion outside the camera's viewing direction. During imagination, ScanDreamer propagates the quadrotor pose over a frozen map and derives progress and wall-contact signals from the mapped geometry. We train ScanDreamer for 0.8 million environment steps (5.5 h on one GPU) and evaluate it in NVIDIA Isaac Sim over 1560 episodes spanning unseen layouts and parameter ranges. Across three seeds (mean SD), ScanDreamer achieves 96.3 0.3% success with 3.6 0.3% collision, compared with 59.6 3.0% success and 28.8 2.8% collision for AirDreamer at the same online-interaction budget. Removing the forward-cone penalty increases collisions to 9.9 3.1%. These results show that combining explicit map memory, map-grounded imagination, and perception-aware motion substantially improves navigation performance and data efficiency. The source code is available at https://github.com/WANGSHUAIzzzz/ScanDreamer.

title_zh: ScanDreamer：一种地图锚定的四旋翼导航世界模型
abstract_zh: 四旋翼在巡检建筑物和隧道时，必须在未知杂乱环境中导航，而前视深度相机有限的视野限制了场景理解和避障导航。近期的世界模型智能体通过想象经验学习导航（例如 AirDreamer），但仍然依赖大量数据，且往往缺乏显式的几何记忆以及对相机可观测范围的感知。我们提出 ScanDreamer，一种地图锚定的世界模型，它根据深度图像和飞行器位姿构建在线 2D 扫描记忆地图。我们的世界模型、actor 和 critic 均以该地图为条件，该地图还定义了测地线进度奖励。此外，前向锥惩罚抑制相机视线方向之外的水平运动。在想象过程中，ScanDreamer 在冻结的地图上传播四旋翼位姿，并根据建图几何推导进度与墙体接触信号。我们将 ScanDreamer 训练 80 万个环境步（单 GPU 上 5.5 小时），并在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中通过 1560 个回合进行评估，覆盖未见过的布局和参数范围。在三个随机种子下（均值±标准差），ScanDreamer 达到 96.3±0.3% 的成功率和 3.6±0.3% 的碰撞率；在相同在线交互预算下，AirDreamer 的成功率为 59.6±3.0%，碰撞率为 28.8±2.8%。移除前向锥惩罚会使碰撞率升至 9.9±3.1%。这些结果表明，结合显式地图记忆、基于地图的想象和考虑感知的运动，可以显著提升导航性能和数据效率。源代码见 https://github.com/WANGSHUAIzzzz/ScanDreamer。

title: Simulation-aided Reinforcement Learning with Control Variates
abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms often rely on data collected from a target environment, which can be expensive and noisy. Although simulators can generate large amounts of additional data, standard simulation mixing approaches, which directly combine simulated and real experience, can degrade performance due to simulator inaccuracies, especially when they bias the solution away from the optimal policy. We propose a conservative simulation-aided learning method based on control variates, where simulated data is used solely to reduce variance in the learning process rather than directly shaping the learning target. We develop our approach for Policy-Evaluation, which is a fundamental building block of RL algorithms. Then we combine it within the actor-critic framework towards policy improvement, as well as extend it towards offline RL scenarios. Experiments on multiple MuJoCo benchmark tasks demonstrate improvements over standard simulation mixing approaches, highlighting control variates as an effective tool for simulation-aided reinforcement learning.

title_zh: 基于控制变量的仿真辅助强化学习
abstract_zh: 强化学习 (RL) 算法通常依赖从目标环境采集的数据，而这类数据可能代价高昂且噪声较大。尽管仿真器可以生成大量额外数据，但直接结合仿真经验与真实经验的标准仿真混合方法可能因仿真器不准确而降低性能，尤其是当这些不准确使解偏离最优策略时。我们提出一种基于控制变量的保守仿真辅助学习方法，其中仿真数据仅用于降低学习过程中的方差，而不是直接塑造学习目标。我们针对策略评估 (Policy-Evaluation) 开发了该方法，这是 RL 算法的基础构件。随后，我们将其结合到 actor-critic 框架中以实现策略改进，并将其扩展到离线 RL 场景。在多个 MuJoCo 基准任务上的实验表明，该方法相较标准仿真混合方法有所改进，凸显了控制变量作为仿真辅助强化学习有效工具的价值。

title: What kills v-prediction? A Patch-wise PCA Perspective on Pixel-Space Flow Matching
abstract: Latent Diffusion Models dominate generative modeling but face two-stage training complexity and the inherent reconstruction limits of pre-trained autoencoders. Pixel-space Flow Matching offers a simplified end-to-end alternative yet often encounters training difficulties when using the standard v-prediction objective. Recent research attributes this difficulty to the off-manifold nature of noised targets, motivating a shift toward x-prediction. In this paper, we investigate this explanation through patch-wise Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and identify a bandwidth bottleneck. The velocity in minor components is largely determined by the raw noisy input, requiring deep backbones to preserve information that competes with principal-component modeling. Through controlled experiments and representation analysis, we further examine why x-prediction remains effective: its parameterization provides a raw-input bypass, while its learned input representation can spontaneously concentrate on principal directions. Under low-rank observations, our analysis of the induced flow characterizes x-prediction as an implicit conditional-mean decoder, reconstructing discarded components from the retained information. These observations motivate the Raw-injected Transformer (RiT), which combines a lightweight raw-conditioned decoder with an output-side shortcut to separate semantic modeling from raw-state propagation. Our method restores effective v-prediction and achieves competitive performance on ImageNet 256256, providing a perspective on the interaction between prediction objectives and architectural bandwidth.

title_zh: 是什么扼杀了 v-prediction？从 Patch 级 PCA 视角看像素空间流匹配
abstract_zh: Latent Diffusion Models 主导了生成建模，但面临两阶段训练的复杂性以及预训练自编码器固有的重建限制。像素空间流匹配提供了一种简化的端到端替代方案，但在使用标准 v-prediction 目标时经常遇到训练困难。近期研究将这一困难归因于加噪目标偏离流形 (off-manifold) 的性质，从而推动了向 x-prediction 的转变。本文通过 Patch 级主成分分析 (PCA) 研究这一解释，并识别出一个带宽瓶颈。次要分量中的速度在很大程度上由原始含噪输入决定，这要求深层骨干网络保留与主成分建模相竞争的信息。通过受控实验和表示分析，我们进一步考察了 x-prediction 为何仍然有效：其参数化提供了原始输入的旁路，而其学习到的输入表示能够自发地集中于主方向。在低秩观测下，我们对诱导流的分析将 x-prediction 刻画为隐式条件均值解码器，从保留的信息中重建被丢弃的分量。这些观察促成了 Raw-injected Transformer (RiT)，它将轻量级的原始输入条件解码器与输出侧捷径相结合，以将语义建模与原始状态传播分离。我们的方法恢复了有效的 v-prediction，并在 ImageNet 256×256 上取得了有竞争力的性能，为预测目标与架构带宽之间的相互作用提供了视角。

title: Benchmarking Real-World Robotic Manipulation through Stochastic Challenges
abstract: A challenging bottleneck in manipulation research is reproducibility and comparability of methods in real-world environments. Since manipulation is an interactive task, it cannot be evaluated on a static dataset of observations. Benchmarking in simulation is a common remedy, but cannot cover the whole complexity of real-world tests. This paper proposes a new paradigm of stochastic challenges. Like the well-known YCB objects, it is based on reproducible real-world scenes and therefore allows system-level innovation and comparability between different platforms. Due to their stochastic nature, our challenges however, mimic the rigor and surprise of hidden test sets. To this end, we show how different robots in different labs can be compared based on their success rate over different random task samples, if these samples come from the same distribution. We propose stochastic challenges as a general paradigm for robot benchmarking and implement this paradigm in a novel benchmark for mobile manipulation, on which we compare two robots tested in two different labs.
comment: Accepted at the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026). 15 pages, 3 figures

Benchmarking in simulation is a common remedy, but cannot cover the whole complexity of real-world tests. This paper proposes a new paradigm of stochastic challenges. Like the well-known YCB

title_zh: 通过随机挑战对真实世界机器人操作进行基准测试
abstract_zh: 操作研究中一个具有挑战性的瓶颈是真实世界环境中方法的可复现性和可比性。由于操作是一项交互式任务，无法在静态观测数据集上进行评估。仿真基准测试是一种常见的补救措施，但无法覆盖真实世界测试的全部复杂性。本文提出一种新的随机挑战范式。与众所周知的 YCB 物体类似，它基于可复现的真实世界场景，因此能够支持系统级创新以及不同平台之间的可比性。然而，由于其随机性，我们的挑战还能模拟隐藏测试集的严谨性与意外性。为此，我们展示了如果不同实验室的不同机器人所面对的不同随机任务样本来自同一分布，如何基于它们在这些样本上的成功率进行比较。我们提出将随机挑战作为机器人基准测试的一种通用范式，并在一个面向移动操作的新基准中实现该范式，在该基准上比较了两个在不同实验室测试的机器人。

title: Reward-Estimated Hypergradient for Bilevel Reinforcement Learning with Black-Box Follower
abstract: Hypergradient (HG) methods for bilevel reinforcement learning (RL) typically assume a white-box follower whose reward is known. In practice, however, the leader rarely knows the follower's reward function and can only observe its trajectories. We address this black-box setting and propose Reward-Estimated Hypergradients (RE-HG), which recovers the follower's reward from these trajectories via inverse RL (IRL). Yet IRL identifies the reward only up to potential-based shaping, a transformation that leaves the follower's behavior unchanged but biases the HG. We prove that, for linear rewards, this bias cancels when IRL estimates are aggregated across sufficiently diverse dynamics, which the leader's own updates naturally supply. To handle finite samples, RE-HG truncates small eigenvalues of the aggregated feature covariance, restoring the identifiable subspace and stabilizing the estimation. Experiments show that RE-HG estimates gradients aligned with a white-box Oracle and achieves comparable performance; empirically, the truncation also suppresses HG explosions, letting RE-HG avoid local optima that trap the Oracle in sharp reward landscapes.

title_zh: 用于黑盒跟随者双层强化学习的奖励估计超梯度
abstract_zh: 用于双层强化学习（RL）的超梯度（HG）方法通常假设跟随者是白盒的，即其奖励已知。然而在实践中，领导者很少知道跟随者的奖励函数，只能观察到其轨迹。我们研究这一黑盒设定，并提出奖励估计超梯度（RE-HG），通过逆强化学习（IRL）从这些轨迹中恢复跟随者的奖励。然而，IRL 只能将奖励识别到基于势能的奖励塑形（potential-based shaping）程度；这种变换不会改变跟随者的行为，却会使 HG 产生偏差。我们证明，对于线性奖励，当 IRL 估计在足够多样的动力学上聚合时，这种偏差会相互抵消，而领导者自身的更新自然会提供这种多样性。为处理有限样本，RE-HG 会对聚合特征协方差的小特征值进行截断，从而恢复可辨识子空间并稳定估计。实验表明，RE-HG 估计的梯度与白盒 Oracle 对齐，并取得相当的性能；经验上，该截断还能抑制 HG 爆炸，使 RE-HG 避免陷入尖锐奖励地形中困住 Oracle 的局部最优。

title: GeoMind: A Benchmark for Spatial Understanding in Robotic Manipulation
abstract: Robotic manipulation has advanced rapidly in mapping visual observations and language instructions to actions. However, reliable manipulation in open-world environments requires robust spatial understanding: the ability to identify targets in complex layouts (spatial reasoning) and adapt to scenes that continuously evolve through interaction (spatial memory). Yet existing embodied benchmarks fall short in evaluating spatial understanding: they often introduce strong visual cues that bypass spatial reasoning, and focus on static scenes that offer little insight into an agent's capacity for spatial memory. To address this gap, we introduce GeoMind, a systematic benchmark for structured spatial understanding through tabletop manipulation. GeoMind comprises 54 evaluated task variants organized around spatial reasoning and spatial memory. It also incorporates a scalable pipeline that automates the generation and annotation of task instances with verified targets and executable interactions. Extensive evaluations across diverse embodied agents reveal their consistent weaknesses in spatial understanding. Our findings highlight that these agents struggle to track identities after spatial changes and convert relational or geometric constraints into executable actions. We release the GeoMind benchmark at https://github.com/Notfound-JH/GEOMIND-benchmark.git.

title_zh: GeoMind：面向机器人操作空间理解的基准
abstract_zh: 机器人操作在将视觉观测和语言指令映射为动作方面已取得快速进展。然而，开放世界环境中的可靠操作需要稳健的空间理解能力：既要在复杂布局中识别目标（空间推理），也要适应通过交互持续演变的场景（空间记忆）。然而，现有具身基准在评估空间理解方面仍显不足：它们通常会引入强烈的视觉线索，从而绕过空间推理，并且聚焦于静态场景，难以揭示智能体的空间记忆能力。为填补这一空白，我们提出 GeoMind，一个通过桌面操作系统评估结构化空间理解的基准。GeoMind 包含 54 个评估任务变体，围绕空间推理和空间记忆组织。它还包含一条可扩展的流水线，可自动生成和标注任务实例，并确保目标经过验证且交互可执行。对多种具身智能体的广泛评估揭示了它们在空间理解方面的一致弱点。我们的发现强调，这些智能体难以在空间变化后跟踪身份，也难以将关系约束或几何约束转化为可执行动作。我们公开发布 GeoMind 基准：https://github.com/Notfound-JH/GEOMIND-benchmark.git。

title: LO-World: Unified BEV Latent Modeling for Joint 4D Occupancy and LiDAR Forecasting
abstract: LiDAR point clouds and 3D semantic occupancy represent two distinct modalities capturing fine-grained metric geometry and dense volumetric semantics, respectively, holding natural potential for mutual complementarity. However, existing world models typically forecast these modalities independently or cascade them heuristically, missing the opportunity for reciprocal cross-modal regularization. To address this, we propose LO-World, a unified 4D world model that forecasts both modalities within a shared BEV latent space. This single-stream formulation enables dense semantics and metric geometry to mutually reinforce each other, while eliminating multi-pipeline redundancy. Specifically, LO-World couples an efficient hybrid range-voxel autoencoder with a flow-matching generator that caches historical context to reduce iterative sampling latency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LO-World outperforms prior state-of-the-art baselines, improving occupancy forecasting IoU by 10.9% and reducing LiDAR Chamfer Distance by 30.1%. Meanwhile, it sustains a real-time throughput exceeding 25 FPS on a single RTX 4090. Our code is available at https://github.com/lzzzzzm/LO-World.

title_zh: LO-World：用于联合 4D 占据与 LiDAR 预测的统一 BEV 隐空间建模
abstract_zh: LiDAR 点云和 3D 语义占据分别代表两种不同的模态，前者捕捉细粒度的度量几何，后者捕捉稠密的体积语义，二者天然具有互补潜力。然而，现有世界模型通常独立预测这两种模态，或以启发式方式将它们级联，错失了跨模态相互正则化的机会。为此，我们提出 LO-World，一个在共享 BEV 隐空间中同时预测两种模态的统一 4D 世界模型。这种单流式建模使稠密语义与度量几何能够相互增强，同时消除多流水线冗余。具体而言，LO-World 将高效混合 range-voxel 自编码器与流匹配生成器相结合，后者缓存历史上下文以降低迭代采样延迟。大量实验表明，LO-World 优于先前的最先进基线，将占据预测 IoU 提升 10.9%，并将 LiDAR Chamfer Distance 降低 30.1%。同时，它在单张 RTX 4090 上保持超过 25 FPS 的实时吞吐量。代码见 https://github.com/lzzzzzm/LO-World。

title: CADMA: Capacity-Aware Coverage Decomposition for Generative Model Assessment
abstract: Evaluating generative models requires measuring not only sample fidelity but also how well a generated set covers the real data distribution. Recent work has therefore introduced recall-oriented metrics for distribution-level evaluation. However, existing recall metrics often reduce distributional coverage to geometry-based coverage. This simplifying assumption weakens their diagnostic value and interpretability in two ways: these metrics provide only a single aggregate score that cannot distinguish essential diversity failures such as mode dropping and mode collapse, and geometry-based coverage can provide unreliable estimates by assigning high scores to poorly covered generative distributions. We therefore introduce CADMA, a capacity-aware framework for recall-oriented evaluation and diagnosis. CADMA evaluates distributional coverage through local capacity matching between real and generated samples, separating geometry-based coverage from effective coverage. This yields multi-dimensional coverage diagnostics that quantify mode dropping and mode collapse while reducing the overly optimistic estimates produced by geometry-based metrics. Through extensive experiments on toy data, real-world datasets, and generative models, we show that CADMA provides more reliable coverage estimates and more fine-grained, interpretable diagnostic signals of diversity failures than existing metrics. Our code is available at https://github.com/Open-Debin/CADMA_NeurIPS2026.

title_zh: CADMA：面向生成模型评估的容量感知覆盖分解
abstract_zh: 评估生成模型不仅需要衡量样本保真度，还需要衡量生成集合对真实数据分布的覆盖程度。因此，近期工作引入了面向召回率的指标，用于分布级评估。然而，现有召回率指标通常将分布覆盖简化为基于几何的覆盖。这一简化假设从两方面削弱了其诊断价值和可解释性：这些指标只提供单一的聚合分数，无法区分模式丢弃（mode dropping）和模式坍塌（mode collapse）等关键多样性失效；并且，基于几何的覆盖可能通过给覆盖较差的生成分布赋予高分而产生不可靠的估计。因此，我们提出 CADMA，一个面向召回率评估与诊断的容量感知框架。CADMA 通过真实样本与生成样本之间的局部容量匹配来评估分布覆盖，将基于几何的覆盖与有效覆盖区分开。这产生了多维覆盖诊断，可量化模式丢弃和模式坍塌，同时减少基于几何的指标所产生的过于乐观的估计。通过在玩具数据、真实世界数据集和生成模型上的大量实验，我们表明 CADMA 比现有指标提供更可靠的覆盖估计，以及更细粒度、更可解释的多样性失效诊断信号。代码见 https://github.com/Open-Debin/CADMA_NeurIPS2026。

title: Thermo-VLA: A Thermal-Aware Vision-Language-Action Model with Gated Residual Modulation for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have begun incorporating thermal sensing, but existing approaches typically treat thermal images as ordinary visual inputs, providing limited support for temperature-aware relational reasoning in manipulation. To address this limitation, we propose Thermo-VLA with a ThermoRes Encoder, which decomposes thermal images into cold and hot attribute representations and injects them into the RGB token through language-conditioned residual modulation, enabling temperature-driven target selection and continuous manipulation. We further construct six real-world robotic tasks on a dual-arm Unitree G1 platform, spanning basic grounding to relational reasoning. Experiments show that Thermo-VLA achieves an average success rate of 0.86 across four thermal-dependent tasks, outperforming a pi_0.5 baseline that directly incorporates RGB-thermal observations by 18 percentage points. Under unseen-object and scene variations, Thermo-VLA maintains an average success rate of 0.78, achieving the best generalisation performance among the compared methods. Beyond thermal sensing, we transfer the same residual modulation mechanism to colour attributes and observe consistent improvements in both simulation and real-robot experiments, indicating its potential to generalise beyond thermal attributes. Project website: https://j-x-chen.github.io/Thermo-VLA-web/

title_zh: Thermo-VLA：一种用于机器人操作的、带门控残差调制的热感知视觉-语言-动作模型
abstract_zh: 近期的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已开始引入热传感，但现有方法通常将热图像视为普通视觉输入，难以为操作中的温度感知关系推理提供充分支持。为解决这一局限，我们提出 Thermo-VLA，并设计 ThermoRes Encoder；该编码器将热图像分解为冷、热属性表示，并通过语言条件残差调制将其注入 RGB token，从而实现温度驱动的目标选择和连续操作。我们进一步在双臂 Unitree G1 平台上构建了六个真实世界机器人任务，涵盖从基础定位到关系推理的任务范围。实验表明，Thermo-VLA 在四个依赖热信息的任务上取得 0.86 的平均成功率，比直接融合 RGB-热观测的 pi_0.5 基线高出 18 个百分点。在未见物体和场景变化下，Thermo-VLA 保持 0.78 的平均成功率，在对比方法中取得最佳泛化性能。除热传感外，我们将相同的残差调制机制迁移到颜色属性，并在仿真和真实机器人实验中观察到一致的改进，表明其具有超越热属性的泛化潜力。项目网站：https://j-x-chen.github.io/Thermo-VLA-web/

title: Direct Trajectory Optimization for Inference-Time Alignment of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
abstract: Alignment of text-to-image diffusion models with reward functions is a key challenge in controllable generation. Existing approaches typically rely on optimizing model inputs or fine-tuning denoising networks, which requires computationally expensive backpropagation through large denoising models. In this work, we propose Direct Trajectory Optimization (DTO), a training-free framework that performs alignment by directly optimizing the sampling trajectory of diffusion models. Specifically, DTO treats intermediate denoising scores and sampled noise as the optimization variables, eliminating the need for gradients through the denoising network. To mitigate the out-of-distribution problem, we introduce Reward-Optimized Score Guidance, which interpolates between the optimized scores and the pretrained model predictions to stabilize sampling, while providing a provable theoretical guarantee of reward improvement under constrained distributions. Empirically, DTO improves alignment performance across three diffusion models on two benchmarks, outperforming existing inference-time alignment methods while maintaining high efficiency. These results suggest that trajectory-level optimization is a promising direction for efficient and effective diffusion model alignment.

title_zh: 面向文本到图像扩散模型推理时对齐的直接轨迹优化
abstract_zh: 将文本到图像扩散模型与奖励函数对齐是可控生成中的一项关键挑战。现有方法通常依赖优化模型输入或微调去噪网络，这需要通过大型去噪模型进行计算代价高昂的反向传播。在这项工作中，我们提出直接轨迹优化（DTO），一种无需训练的框架，通过直接优化扩散模型的采样轨迹来实现对齐。具体而言，DTO 将中间去噪分数和采样噪声作为优化变量，从而无需通过去噪网络求梯度。为缓解分布外问题，我们引入奖励优化分数引导（Reward-Optimized Score Guidance），在优化后的分数与预训练模型预测之间进行插值以稳定采样，同时在受限分布下提供可证明的奖励提升理论保证。实证上，DTO 在两个基准上的三个扩散模型中提升了对齐性能，在保持高效率的同时优于现有推理时对齐方法。这些结果表明，轨迹级优化是高效且有效的扩散模型对齐的一个有前景方向。

title: K-PWM: Control-Oriented Structured Bilinear World Models under Partial Observation
abstract: World models learn internal simulators of environment dynamics for prediction, planning, and control, yet learning them from limited, noisy, and partial observations remains challenging. While much progress has focused on pixel-based observations, many physical systems instead provide vector-valued measurements that reveal only part of the underlying state. We introduce K-PWM, a probabilistic world model for prediction and control under partial observation. K-PWM couples Koopman-bilinear latent dynamics with a nonlinear observation decoder and performs probabilistic latent-state inference through the learned model via extended Kalman filtering and smoothing, without a separately trained inference network. Its bilinear structure enables exact propagation of the maintained Gaussian belief through the latent transition and efficient rollouts for uncertainty-aware model predictive path integral (MPPI) control. For training K-PWM, we present a generalized expectation conditional maximization (GECM) procedure with closed-form updates for the generators, noise covariances, and latent prior, complemented by gradient-based decoder learning. A Koopman-consistent initialization selects the latent dimension from data and initializes the action-dependent dynamics. With limited training data, K-PWM achieves lower long-horizon prediction error than the evaluated baselines on partially observed Gymnasium MuJoCo systems, while substantially reducing training time relative to the strongest prediction baseline. On high-dimensional MuJoCo Menagerie robots, it achieves competitive tracking accuracy with low per-step computation times, demonstrating potential for real-time deployment. These results support structured probabilistic dynamics as a data- and compute-efficient approach to world modeling and control under partial observation.

title_zh: K-PWM：部分观测下面向控制的结构化双线性世界模型
abstract_zh: 世界模型学习环境动力学的内部模拟器，用于预测、规划和控制，但从有限、带噪且部分观测的数据中学习世界模型仍然具有挑战性。尽管许多进展集中在基于像素的观测上，但许多物理系统提供的是向量值测量，仅揭示潜在状态的一部分。我们提出 K-PWM，一个用于部分观测下预测与控制的概率世界模型。K-PWM 将 Koopman 双线性隐动力学与非线性观测解码器相结合，并通过学习到的模型，利用扩展卡尔曼滤波和平滑进行概率隐状态推断，而无需单独训练推断网络。其双线性结构使所维护的高斯信念能够通过隐状态转移精确传播，并支持面向不确定性感知的模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制的高效 rollout。为训练 K-PWM，我们提出一种广义期望条件最大化（GECM）过程，为生成器、噪声协方差和隐先验提供闭式更新，并辅以基于梯度的解码器学习。Koopman 一致的初始化会从数据中选择隐维度，并初始化依赖于动作的动力学。在训练数据有限的情况下，K-PWM 在部分观测的 Gymnasium MuJoCo 系统上取得了比所评估基线更低的长时程预测误差，同时相对于最强的预测基线大幅缩短了训练时间。在高维 MuJoCo Menagerie 机器人上，它以较低的每步计算时间取得了有竞争力的跟踪精度，展示了实时部署的潜力。这些结果支持将结构化概率动力学作为一种数据高效且计算高效的方法，用于部分观测下的世界建模与控制。

title: Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation
abstract: Tactile sensing is an indispensable modality for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, a capability that hints at the ultimate frontiers of embodied intelligence. However, commercially available tactile sensors are still at a relatively early stage of development, with each type of sensor offering irreplaceable strengths alongside its own drawbacks. A key challenge is thus to free tactile understanding from sensor-specific physics, so that embodied models can effectively leverage heterogeneous tactile data. To this end, we develop LingBot-Touch, a tactile foundation model characterized by the following properties. (i) Our model yields a unified representation across different tactile sensors (i.e., piezoresistive, magnetic, and visuotactile sensors), and is easily extensible to new sensor types. (ii) The resulting tactile tokens are plug-and-play: they can be seamlessly integrated into policy models across paradigms, from diffusion policy to vision-language-action (VLA) models such as π_0.5 and LingBot-VLA, consistently enhancing manipulation dexterity. (iii) Extensive experiments, spanning simulation and real-robot deployments across multiple hardware platforms, demonstrate that our tactile representation substantially benefits complex manipulation tasks while maintaining strong computational efficiency. We believe the findings in this work demonstrate the potential of leveraging cross-sensor data to scale tactile learning, and offer encouraging insights for the design of future hardware and embodied models.
title_zh: 学习面向通用灵巧操作的异构触觉表征
abstract_zh: 触觉感知是接触丰富型灵巧操作不可或缺的模态，这一能力也指向具身智能的终极前沿。然而，商用触觉传感器仍处于相对早期的发展阶段，每类传感器在具备不可替代优势的同时也各有局限。因此，一个关键挑战是使触觉理解摆脱特定传感器物理特性的束缚，让具身模型能够有效利用异构触觉数据。为此，我们开发了 LingBot-Touch，这是一个具有以下特性的触觉基础模型。(i) 我们的模型能在不同触觉传感器（即压阻式、磁式和视触觉传感器）之间生成统一表征，并且易于扩展到新的传感器类型。(ii) 由此得到的触觉 token 即插即用：它们可以无缝集成到不同范式的策略模型中，从扩散策略（diffusion policy）到 π_0.5、LingBot-VLA 等视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，并持续提升操作灵巧性。(iii) 涵盖仿真和多种硬件平台真实机器人部署的大量实验表明，我们的触觉表征能显著提升复杂操作任务的表现，同时保持较高的计算效率。我们相信，本工作的发现展示了利用跨传感器数据扩展触觉学习规模的潜力，并为未来硬件和具身模型的设计提供了令人鼓舞的启示。

title: Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Clinical Agents: When Dense Rewards Beat Outcome Rewards
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is increasingly used to improve language model reasoning, yet its effects on sequential decision procedures remain poorly understood. We study this problem in clinical multi-turn agents that must decide what information to request, when to stop gathering evidence, and which action to take. We introduce three controlled environments: medication refill triage, acute diagnostic work-up, and dosing titration, each with hidden clinical states, query costs, exact adaptive oracles, and deterministic outcome verifiers. Across these tasks, outcome-only group relative policy optimization often improves aggregate reward while producing undesirable procedures, including premature commitment, one-question collapse, and failures on rare high-risk cases. In diagnostics, assigning dense credit to questions that reduce uncertainty improves held-out value and moderate-case support across three training seeds relative to outcome-only reinforcement learning, without the high-risk seed collapse observed under outcome-only training. Separating exploration from exploitation further increases high-risk support at its best checkpoint, but at the cost of excessive information gathering on low-acuity cases. Additional experiments show that the optimal strength of process credit is task-dependent; that after a supervised warmup that already gathers carefully, reinforcement learning raises aggregate reward by trimming questions while degrading high-risk performance; and that reinforcement learning does not reliably repair rare behavior gaps inherited from biased supervised data. Verifiable final outcomes are therefore insufficient for training reliable multi-turn agents: reward design must account for the procedure used to reach an answer, and evaluation must distinguish adaptive information gathering from reward-exploiting shortcuts.
title_zh: 多轮临床智能体的安全强化学习：密集奖励何时优于结果奖励
abstract_zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习正越来越多地用于提升语言模型推理能力，但其对序贯决策流程的影响仍缺乏充分理解。我们在临床多轮智能体中研究这一问题；这类智能体必须决定请求哪些信息、何时停止收集证据以及采取哪项行动。我们引入三个受控环境：药物续方分诊、急性诊断检查和剂量滴定，每个环境都包含隐藏的临床状态、查询成本、精确的自适应 oracle 以及确定性的结果验证器。在这些任务中，仅使用结果奖励的组相对策略优化（group relative policy optimization）往往会提高总体奖励，却产生不理想的流程，包括过早锁定决策、one-question collapse（单问题坍缩）以及在罕见高风险病例上的失败。在诊断任务中，相对于仅结果强化学习，将密集信用分配给能够降低不确定性的问题，可在三个训练随机种子下提升留出集价值和中等病例上的表现，且未出现仅结果训练中观察到的高风险病例种子崩溃。将探索与利用分离可进一步提升最佳检查点上的高风险病例表现，但代价是在低急症程度病例上收集了过多信息。额外实验表明：过程信用的最优强度取决于任务；在已经能谨慎收集信息的监督式预热之后，强化学习会通过削减问题数量来提高总体奖励，同时降低高风险病例上的表现；强化学习也无法可靠修复由有偏监督数据继承而来的罕见行为缺口。因此，可验证的最终结果不足以训练可靠的多轮智能体：奖励设计必须考虑得出答案所采用的流程，评估也必须区分自适应信息收集与利用奖励漏洞的捷径。

title: Decoupled Asynchronous System for Humanoids (DASH): Latency-Agnostic Scaling of Vision-Language-Action Models for Humanoid Manipulation
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models pair a vision-language backbone with an action head, but in closed-loop control the backbone sits on the control-critical path: while it computes, the robot keeps moving, so each executed action is conditioned on an increasingly stale observation. A larger backbone therefore directly blocks reactivity, especially in humanoid dexterous manipulation. We present DASH, a Decoupled Asynchronous System for Humanoids that removes this coupling. DASH splits the policy into a slow vision-language model (System 2) and a fast flow-matching action head (System 1) that run as concurrent processes over the LCM communication protocol, so the control rate is set by the action head alone, independent of backbone size. The action head fuses stale semantics from a frozen backbone with fresh vision from its own ResNet encoder, desynchronized training exposes it to the staleness it meets at deployment, and an adaptive temporal aggregator aligns overlapping action chunks under variable inference latency. On an asynchronous RoboTwin benchmark that charges inference latency in simulated time, DASH holds 20 Hz control rate from 0.8B to 8B backbones while the synchronous rate falls from 9.7 to 4.1 Hz, with higher success at every size. On a real humanoid with dexterous hands, DASH achieves clearly higher pick-and-place success than the synchronous pipeline.
title_zh: 面向人形机器人的解耦异步系统（DASH）：用于人形操作的视觉-语言-动作模型延迟无关扩展
abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将视觉-语言主干与动作头结合，但在闭环控制中，主干位于控制关键路径上：在其计算期间，机器人仍在运动，因此每个已执行动作所依据的观测会越来越陈旧。因此，更大的主干会直接阻碍反应能力，在人形灵巧操作中尤为如此。我们提出 DASH，一种面向人形机器人的解耦异步系统，用于消除这种耦合。DASH 将策略拆分为一个慢速视觉-语言模型（System 2）和一个快速流匹配动作头（System 1），二者通过 LCM 通信协议作为并发进程运行，因此控制频率仅由动作头决定，与主干规模无关。动作头将来自冻结主干的陈旧语义与其自身 ResNet 编码器提供的新鲜视觉信息融合；去同步训练使它接触到部署时会遇到的陈旧性；自适应时间聚合器则在推理延迟变化时对齐相互重叠的动作块。在按仿真时间计入推理延迟的异步 RoboTwin 基准上，DASH 在 0.8B 至 8B 主干规模下保持 20 Hz 控制频率，而同步方案的控制频率从 9.7 Hz 降至 4.1 Hz；DASH 在每种规模下成功率都更高。在配备灵巧手的真实人形机器人上，DASH 的抓取放置成功率明显高于同步流水线。

title: Zero-Search Reinforcement Learning for Slay the Spire 2 with Failure-Driven Restarts
abstract: Slay the Spire 2 (STS2) is a deck-building roguelike in which a winning run at the highest difficulty takes several hundred decisions, and most losses happen in late boss fights that a learner seldom reaches. We train agents that choose every action with one forward pass of a 6.6M-parameter entity transformer, without lookahead. Training and evaluation run the game's own compiled assembly (v0.107.1) in a headless .NET host. The host replays a run exactly from its seed and actions, so training episodes can restart from states the learner has visited, and a failure-driven curriculum allocates these restarts in proportion to where complete runs are lost. On 12,800 held-out games at Ascension 10 (A10), the released policies win 8.05% averaged over the five characters (Ironclad 15.6%, Regent 12.5%), and AlphaSpire's released networks used without search win 0.55% on a common panel. Longer A10 training raised Ironclad from 12.4% to 15.6% and Defect from 3.0% to 8.1% on these games. At Ascension 0 the released policies win 80.2%, level with the 80.3% that the tree-search agent Spire Mentor reports, while Mentor leads by 5 to 8 points from A4 upward. Run in our host on the same 2,000 A10 games, Mentor's search wins 8.8% against 8.2% for our policies, which need 21-27 ms per decision on one CPU core. GPT-6 Astra at maximum reasoning won none of 11 A10 games through our text interface. In a controlled study of 18 training runs from six random initializations, failure-driven allocation exceeds uniform restart allocation on each of three Regent initializations, by 3.6 percentage points on average, while the Silent effect is small and changes sign. Code, trained policies, an in-game mod and the records behind every table are at https://github.com/HalfVulpes/sts2ai.
