title_zh: Agentic-OPD：通过 On-Policy Distillation 恢复智能体任务中被遗忘的能力
abstract_zh: 强化学习如今是在智能体任务上训练 LLM 的主流范式，但标准做法只保留验证集表现最佳的检查点，而丢弃其余检查点。我们表明这种做法会造成信息损失：在使用 GRPO 训练 LLM 智能体时，最佳验证检查点会在同一次运行中较早检查点已经解决的问题上失败，而各检查点所解决问题的并集远远超过任何单个检查点。因此，被丢弃的检查点构成了一个无需额外训练成本即可获得的教师池，on-policy distillation（OPD）可以从中挖掘信息，以恢复丢失的覆盖范围。挖掘该教师池带来两个挑战：i）应从哪个检查点进行蒸馏，因为没有任何检查点能全面优于其他检查点，且其与学生模型的互补性因问题而异；ii）应在何处信任该教师，因为即使选择得当，教师也只在局部更优，不加区分的蒸馏会覆盖学生已经掌握的行为。我们提出 Agentic-OPD，将最佳验证检查点作为学生，将所有已保存检查点作为冻结的候选教师，并利用学生不断变化的能力差距来同时指导教师选择和监督过滤：HCN（Highest Coverage Next）策略根据教师对学生未解决问题的加权覆盖情况动态选择教师，而 LAD（Locality-Aware Distillation）模块将迁移限制在学生失败的 rollout 中且教师表现更好的问题上。在五个智能体任务领域、24 个基准和任务子集上，Agentic-OPD 相比其初始化检查点最高提升 7.4 分，其中 4B 学生模型在深度搜索上超过了最新前沿模型 GPT-5.6 和 DeepSeek-V4.1。Agentic-OPD 将一次已完成的 RL 运行重塑为可复用的策略池，并将 RL 后的能力恢复确立为与 RL 算法本身改进正交的一个阶段。

title: AgentOPSD: Turn-Level Credit Assignment via Recursive Belief Revision
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards ordinarily spreads a single advantage over a whole trajectory, a granularity too coarse to isolate the few decisions on which success in a long, multi-turn interaction actually turns. Privileged self-distillation supplies denser supervision, but it leaves unanswered how a set of local teacher-student discrepancies should be converted into credit along a sequence. We introduce AgentOPSD, a critic-free scheme that assigns credit recursively, one interaction turn at a time. Inside a turn, the token-level log-probability gaps between a skill-conditioned self-teacher and the student are summed, and that sum acts as evidence in a recursive Bayesian update carried out in log-odds space; the resulting revisions reallocate the outcome-derived advantage across turns through a multiplier that is bounded and preserves its sign. With Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B as policy backbones on ALFWorld, the method improves consistently on GRPO and on self-distillation baselines, and attains 89.1% success at the 7B scale. Ablations attribute the gain to aggregating evidence at turn boundaries and to making the belief revision depend on history, rather than to the local gap by itself.
title_zh: AgentOPSD：基于递归信念修正的轮级信用分配
abstract_zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习通常将单一优势值分摊到整条轨迹上，这一粒度过粗，无法隔离出长程多轮交互中真正决定成败的少数决策。特权自蒸馏（privileged self-distillation）提供了更密集的监督，但尚未回答应如何将一组局部的教师—学生差异沿序列转换为信用。我们提出 AgentOPSD，一种无 critic 的方案，每次交互轮递归地分配信用。在一轮内部，对以技能为条件的自教师与学生之间的 token 级对数概率差求和，并将该和作为证据，在对数几率空间中进行递归贝叶斯更新；由此产生的修正在各轮之间通过一个有界且保持符号的乘子重新分配由结果导出的优势。在 ALFWorld 上以 Qwen2.5-3B 和 Qwen2.5-7B 作为策略骨干时，该方法相较 GRPO 和自蒸馏基线均有一致提升，并在 7B 规模达到 89.1% 的成功率。消融实验将增益归因于在轮次边界聚合证据，以及让信念修正依赖历史，而非归因于局部差距本身。

title: A Modular Perspective for Modeling MARL Systems
abstract: The growing complexity of Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) has fragmented the literature, obscuring underlying architectural choices behind diverse implementations. This fragmentation makes it difficult to evaluate critical modeling dimensions in isolation, identify how components affect the resulting system dynamics, and compare, reuse, or combine contributions across the literature. This paper proposes a modular perspective for modeling, analyzing, and implementing MARL systems. We decompose them into eight functional modules: agents, environments, learning, reward modeling, training and execution modes, communication, modeling of other agents, and evaluation criteria. For each module, we clarify its role and review representative approaches. We instantiate this decomposition in MARLKIT, a framework whose modules are explicit and interchangeable. MARLKIT demonstrates how the proposed perspective supports transparent experimental assumptions and the controlled variation and combination of MARL mechanisms. Experiments illustrate its ability to prototype, compare, reuse and combine modules while making differences between configurations explicit. Overall, the paper provides a structured perspective on MARL modeling and implementation, offering a common language for making modeling choices explicit, supporting clearer descriptions of MARL approaches, and supporting more controlled experimentation through the systematic isolation and combination of MARL mechanisms.
title_zh: MARL 系统建模的模块化视角
abstract_zh: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）日益增长的复杂性使文献日趋碎片化，将底层架构选择隐藏在多样的实现之后。这种碎片化使得人们难以孤立评估关键的建模维度、识别各组件如何影响最终的系统动力学，也难以跨文献比较、复用或组合各项贡献。本文提出一种用于 MARL 系统建模、分析和实现的模块化视角。我们将 MARL 系统分解为八个功能模块：智能体、环境、学习、奖励建模、训练与执行模式、通信、对其他智能体的建模，以及评估标准。对于每个模块，我们阐明其作用并回顾代表性方法。我们在 MARLKIT 中实例化这一分解；MARLKIT 是一个模块显式且可互换的框架。MARLKIT 展示了所提视角如何支持透明的实验假设，以及对 MARL 机制进行受控变化与组合。实验表明，该框架能够对模块进行原型设计、比较、复用和组合，同时使不同配置之间的差异显式化。总体而言，本文为 MARL 建模与实现提供了一个结构化视角，提供了一种使建模选择显式化的共同语言，支持更清晰地描述 MARL 方法，并通过系统性地隔离和组合 MARL 机制来支持更受控的实验。

title: Particle Filtering with Generative Trajectory Models for State Estimation and Control
abstract: Generative models can support both state estimation and control in robotics. For control, a common approach is to use the model as a policy that directly samples actions conditioned on observation histories. However, models that jointly represent states, actions, and observations can also predict how the robot state and its environment evolve. We investigate whether these predictions can improve state estimation and control through a change in inference procedure, without modifying the pretrained model. To this end, we use particle filtering to maintain competing hypotheses about state histories. A single pretrained diffusion model generates these hypotheses along with their predicted observations and associated action proposals. As new measurements arrive, particles are reweighted according to how well their predicted observations match the measurements. While particle filtering conventionally uses these weights only for state estimation, we also use them to guide action selection, favoring proposals associated with hypotheses that better explain the observations. Simulation experiments in partially observed navigation and vision-based manipulation demonstrate improvements in both state estimation and task performance compared to action generation without filtering, using the same pretrained model and no additional test-time information.
title_zh: 结合生成式轨迹模型的粒子滤波用于状态估计与控制
abstract_zh: 生成式模型可以同时支持机器人领域中的状态估计与控制。在控制方面，一种常见方法是将模型用作策略，直接根据观测历史采样动作。然而，联合表示状态、动作和观测的模型也能够预测机器人状态及其环境将如何演化。我们研究是否可以通过改变推理过程，在不修改预训练模型的情况下，利用这些预测来改进状态估计与控制。为此，我们使用粒子滤波来维护关于状态历史的竞争性假设。单个预训练扩散模型生成这些假设，以及相应的预测观测和关联的动作提议。随着新测量到达，粒子会根据其预测观测与测量的匹配程度重新加权。粒子滤波传统上仅将这些权重用于状态估计，而我们还用它们指导动作选择，偏向与更能解释观测的假设相关联的动作提议。在部分可观测导航和基于视觉的操作仿真实验中，与不进行滤波的动作生成相比，该方法在相同预训练模型且不增加测试时信息的情况下，同时改善了状态估计和任务性能。

title: Certified Zonotopic Reachability Analysis for Trajectory Tracking on Lie Groups
abstract: Autonomous vehicles track planned trajectories close to obstacles. Unknown disturbances make them deviate from these trajectories. With a bound on the tracking error that disturbances can cause, a planned trajectory can be certified as safe before execution. Existing set-based methods bound the tracking error by one invariant ellipsoid for the whole trajectory or by intervals, which are both conservative. For aerial and space vehicles, the tracking error evolves on a matrix Lie group with nonlinear dynamics. However, for group-affine systems, the error dynamics are linear in Lie algebra coordinates when the vehicle receives the inputs of the reference. The control input and the disturbance enter through the inverse right Jacobian, a matrix that depends on the error. We propagate the linear part of the error dynamics with zonotopes and enclose the effect of the inverse right Jacobian on the disturbance in closed form. The resulting tubes are tight and provably contain all reachable tracking errors in continuous time. When some error components have no input, the inverse right Jacobian leaves unmatched nonlinear terms in the closed loop. None of the tested methods certifies such a closed loop. Hybrid coordinates make these terms matched, so that our controller cancels every nonlinear term that does not contain the disturbance. Our tubes give tighter bounds than the ellipsoid method in simulations of a planar aircraft and a fully actuated multirotor and in real flights of a quadrotor, where the tube contains every measured attitude error. Under larger disturbances and the same feedback gain, the ellipsoid method yields no valid ellipsoid, whereas our tubes remain valid.
title_zh: 李群上轨迹跟踪的可认证 zonotopic 可达性分析
abstract_zh: 自主车辆会在靠近障碍物的区域跟踪规划轨迹。未知扰动会使它们偏离这些轨迹。若能给出扰动可能造成的跟踪误差上界，规划轨迹就可以在执行前被认证为安全。现有的基于集合的方法用整条轨迹上的单个不变椭球或区间来界定跟踪误差，二者都较为保守。对于空中和航天车辆，跟踪误差在具有非线性动力学的矩阵李群上演化。然而，对于群仿射（group-affine）系统，当车辆接收参考轨迹的输入时，误差动力学在李代数坐标中是线性的。控制输入和扰动通过逆右雅可比矩阵进入，而该矩阵依赖于误差。我们用 zonotope 传播误差动力学的线性部分，并以闭式形式包络逆右雅可比矩阵对扰动的影响。由此得到的管道（tubes）是紧的，并且可证明在连续时间中包含所有可达的跟踪误差。当某些误差分量没有输入时，逆右雅可比矩阵会在闭环中留下未匹配的非线性项。所测试的方法均无法认证这样的闭环。混合坐标使这些项变为匹配项，因此我们的控制器可以抵消所有不含扰动的非线性项。在平面飞行器和全驱动多旋翼的仿真以及四旋翼的真实飞行中，我们的管道给出的边界比椭球方法更紧；在真实飞行中，管道包含每一个测量到的姿态误差。在更大扰动和相同反馈增益下，椭球方法无法给出有效椭球，而我们的管道仍然有效。

title: QCC-WM: Linking Macro-State Dynamics and Visual Generation via Quotient Causal Construction
abstract: A key challenge in action-conditioned world modeling is to construct macro-states from high-dimensional observations that support recursive prediction under actions, while keeping their predicted evolution consistent with visual changes in generated observations. We propose QCC-WM, a visual world model based on Quotient-based Causal Construction. QCC-WM uses action responses to guide macro-variable construction for recursive action-conditioned prediction. A shared reference quotient measurement constrains the consistency between predicted states and observed changes, allowing macro-level predictions to provide structured constraints for future visual generation. Using translational and rotational actions and their predicted responses, the model aggregates local visual features into macro-nodes with spatial correspondence through causal abstraction, and recursively predicts node content and motion under a shared reference measurement. Macro-level predictions guide future observation generation, while predicted motion transports historical appearance information. Node-level errors between generated observations and macro-level targets are then mapped back to the corresponding spatial regions for correction, improving consistency between visual generation and macro-level predictions. On the US-VLA dataset, QCC-WM achieves an ROI-MSE of 0.01861 for four-step prediction. Compared with the best baseline at each prediction horizon, it reduces LPIPS by 48.59%, 41.68%, and 30.23% for four-step prediction and eight- and sixteen-step recursive extrapolation, respectively. Ablation studies and mechanism analyses show that motion-guided reference transport mainly improves pixel reconstruction, while node-level error feedback further improves perceptual quality and consistency between generated observations and macro-level predictions.
title_zh: QCC-WM：通过 Quotient Causal Construction 连接宏观状态动力学与视觉生成
abstract_zh: 动作条件世界建模的一个关键挑战是：从高维观测中构造宏观状态，使其支持动作条件下的递归预测，同时保持其预测演化与生成观测中的视觉变化一致。我们提出 QCC-WM，一种基于 Quotient-based Causal Construction 的视觉世界模型。QCC-WM 利用动作响应来指导宏观变量构造，以支持动作条件下的递归预测。一种共享参考商测量（shared reference quotient measurement）约束预测状态与观测变化之间的一致性，使宏观层面的预测能够为未来视觉生成提供结构化约束。利用平移和旋转动作及其预测响应，该模型通过因果抽象，将局部视觉特征聚合为具有空间对应关系的宏节点，并在共享参考测量下递归预测节点内容与运动。宏观层面的预测指导未来观测生成，而预测运动则传输历史外观信息。随后，生成观测与宏观层面目标之间的节点级误差会被映射回相应的空间区域进行校正，从而提高视觉生成与宏观层面预测之间的一致性。在 US-VLA 数据集上，QCC-WM 在四步预测中取得 0.01861 的 ROI-MSE。与各预测时域上的最佳基线相比，在四步预测以及八步和十六步递归外推中，LPIPS 分别降低 48.59%、41.68% 和 30.23%。消融研究和机制分析表明，运动引导的参考传输主要改善像素重建，而节点级误差反馈进一步提升了感知质量以及生成观测与宏观层面预测之间的一致性。

title: Learning Evidence-Grounded Reasoning for Context-Aware Time Series Forecasting
abstract: LLM-driven time series forecasting has become increasingly promising by leveraging contextual features to generate future values directly or refine forecast priors. However, incorporating contextual features alone does not ensure that models can identify which features matter for forecasting and understand what they suggest about future dynamics. We argue that the fundamental challenge is how to extract predictive evidence from contextual features and when and how to leverage it to guide forecasting decisions. In this paper, we propose CastReasoner, an evidence-grounded reasoning model for context-aware time series forecasting. Specifically, CastReasoner uses a structured chain of thought (CoT) to extract predictive evidence from contextual features, infer the future dynamics suggested by this evidence, and assess these dynamics against the forecast prior to guide adaptive forecasting decisions. To enable this capability, we design a reasoning-centric two-stage post-training framework including supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). First, we synthesize reasoning trajectories through controllable multi-teacher guidance and select high-quality ones using a novel student-aware difficulty metric. Second, we design fine-grained multi-objective rewards to further improve reasoning and forecasting. To address heterogeneous learning needs across domains in both stages, we introduce a convergence-guided data balancing strategy. Through this two-stage training, CastReasoner improves both reasoning quality and predictive accuracy. Extensive experiments across multi-domain forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that CastReasoner achieves superior forecasting performance.
title_zh: 为上下文感知时间序列预测学习基于证据的推理
abstract_zh: 由 LLM 驱动的时间序列预测通过利用上下文特征直接生成未来值或修正预测先验，正变得愈发有前景。然而，仅纳入上下文特征并不能确保模型能够识别哪些特征对预测重要，也无法理解这些特征对未来动态意味着什么。我们认为，根本挑战在于如何从上下文特征中提取预测证据，以及何时、如何利用这些证据来指导预测决策。本文提出 CastReasoner，一种用于上下文感知时间序列预测的、基于证据的推理模型。具体而言，CastReasoner 使用结构化思维链（chain of thought, CoT）从上下文特征中提取预测证据，推断这些证据所暗示的未来动态，并对照预测先验评估这些动态，以指导自适应预测决策。为实现这一能力，我们设计了一个以推理为中心的两阶段后训练框架，包括监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）。首先，我们通过可控的多教师引导合成推理轨迹，并使用一种新的学生感知难度指标筛选高质量轨迹。其次，我们设计细粒度多目标奖励，以进一步提升推理和预测能力。为应对两个阶段中跨领域异构的学习需求，我们引入收敛引导的数据平衡策略。通过这种两阶段训练，CastReasoner 提升了推理质量和预测准确性。跨多个领域的预测基准上的大量实验表明，CastReasoner 取得了更优的预测性能。

title: Graph-Based RL for Sequential Rendezvous Planning with Multiple Patrolling USVs
abstract: In patrol missions involving multiple unmanned surface vehicles (USVs), a designated command USV can support fleet management by sequentially rendezvousing with each patrolling USV. These operations require motion-feasible route planning and priority-aware rendezvous sequencing, with the objective of minimizing mission completion time and total tardiness relative to priority-dependent due dates. We propose a framework combining grid-based path planning, surrogate travel-time prediction, and graph-based reinforcement learning. The path planner accounts for ocean currents and approximates turn-rate constraints through multi-stage maneuvers, with path feasibility empirically validated through trajectory-tracking simulations. For rendezvous sequencing, a Feasible Transition Graph (FTG) represents candidate rendezvous events and temporally feasible transitions, enabling a graph neural network to exploit spatiotemporal rendezvous relationships for policy learning. A surrogate predicts travel times from compact current and motion features to avoid repeated path searches during FTG construction and policy training. Evaluation using grid-based path planning shows statistically significant average objective reductions of 10.5%, 3.5%, and 1.5% compared with greedy, MLP-RL, and 2-step lookahead greedy, respectively. The policy achieves these improvements while requiring approximately 1/35 of the latter's computation time. It maintains its advantage over MLP-RL under unseen priority-tier settings, with larger gains as fleet size increases.
title_zh: 基于图的强化学习用于多艘巡逻 USV 的顺序会合规划
abstract_zh: 在涉及多艘无人水面艇（USV）的巡逻任务中，指定的指挥 USV 可以通过依次与每艘巡逻 USV 会合来支持船队管理。这些作业需要运动可行的路径规划和优先级感知的会合排序，目标是最小化任务完成时间以及相对于取决于优先级的截止时间的总迟到时间。我们提出了一个结合基于网格的路径规划、代理旅行时间预测和基于图的强化学习的框架。路径规划器考虑洋流，并通过多阶段机动近似转向速率约束，路径可行性经轨迹跟踪仿真得到了经验验证。对于会合排序，可行转移图（Feasible Transition Graph, FTG）表示候选会合事件和时间上可行的转移，使图神经网络能够利用时空会合关系进行策略学习。代理模型根据紧凑的洋流和运动特征预测旅行时间，以避免在 FTG 构建和策略训练期间重复进行路径搜索。使用基于网格的路径规划进行评估，与贪心、MLP-RL 和两步前瞻贪心相比，平均目标分别取得了 10.5%、3.5% 和 1.5% 的统计显著降低。该策略在实现这些改进的同时，所需计算时间约为后者的 1/35。在未见的优先级层级设置下，它仍保持对 MLP-RL 的优势，且随着船队规模增大收益更大。

title: SkillDuet: Co-Evolving Models and Skills through Response Feedback
abstract: During reinforcement learning, experience can be both internalized in LLM parameters and retained externally as reusable textual skills. Parameter updates alter the model's behavior and the interaction experience from which new skills are extracted. These skills, in turn, guide the model's subsequent interactions and parameter updates. As the model's capabilities evolve, previously beneficial skills may become redundant or detrimental. We present SkillDuet, a framework that coordinates parameter updates and skill evolution through model response feedback. Skills extracted from on-policy trajectories guide parameter updates through OPD at every step. A response-based score, Strength, ranks candidate skills by the magnitude of the shift they induce in the current model's responses, and the highest-scoring skills are periodically consolidated into a persistent global skill set (Global). The updated model and Global jointly guide subsequent interactions, generating experience for further parameter and skill updates. With Qwen3-4B, SkillDuet achieves success rates of 98.57% on ALFWorld and 92.97% on WebShop, exceeding the matched SEED-API baseline by 2.86 and 5.47 percentage points, respectively. Ablations show that response-based skill selection and Global consolidation improve task performance. Further experiments show that the benefits of retained skills depend on both their content and their compatibility with the model. SkillDuet provides a concrete mechanism for model-skill co-evolution and skill-level recursive self-improvement.
title_zh: SkillDuet：通过响应反馈协同演化模型与技能
abstract_zh: 在强化学习过程中，经验既可以内化到 LLM 参数中，也可以作为可复用的文本技能保留在外部。参数更新会改变模型的行为以及从中提取新技能的交互经验。反过来，这些技能又会指导模型后续的交互和参数更新。随着模型能力演化，先前有益的技能可能变得冗余甚至有害。我们提出 SkillDuet，一个通过模型响应反馈协调参数更新与技能演化的框架。从同策略轨迹中提取的技能在每一步通过 OPD 指导参数更新。一种基于响应的评分 Strength 根据候选技能对当前模型响应所引发变化的幅度对其进行排序，得分最高的技能会被周期性地整合到一个持久化的全局技能集（Global）中。更新后的模型和 Global 共同指导后续交互，生成用于进一步参数和技能更新的经验。在 Qwen3-4B 上，SkillDuet 在 ALFWorld 上达到 98.57% 的成功率，在 WebShop 上达到 92.97% 的成功率，分别超过匹配的 SEED-API 基线 2.86 和 5.47 个百分点。消融实验表明，基于响应的技能选择和 Global 整合提升了任务性能。进一步实验表明，保留技能带来的收益既取决于其内容，也取决于其与模型的兼容性。SkillDuet 为模型—技能协同演化和技能层面的递归自我改进提供了一种具体机制。

title: Trajectory Density Ratios under Weak Support: A Survey across the Sciences
abstract: Many problems across the sciences compare two stochastic processes through the sequences they generate. Reinforcement learning asks what a new policy would return from the trajectories of an old one; molecular simulation asks how much more a ligand binds from samples of the unbound state; climate attribution asks how a heat wave shifted under warming; and language-model post-training asks what a deployed agent will do from logged interactions. In every case, one quantity would answer all these questions at once: the ratio of the two probability laws over their generated sequences, the trajectory density ratio. This ratio exists only under strong conditions. When one process reaches states the other cannot, the ratio does not exist; when their overlap is thin, its variance grows without control with the sequence length; and when they concentrate on different lower-dimensional sets, the ratio is undefined altogether. Weak support of this kind is the norm for sequence data, not a sampling accident, and its price is paid in identifiability rather than in noise alone. This survey organizes the field around a three-level diagnosis of weak support and a map of the nine retreats that methods take when the full ratio is out of reach, from direct estimation and reweighting through staged decomposition, stationarization, and partial-identification bounds to smoothing, transport couplings, operator spectra, and direct estimation of a single functional. Each retreat keeps part of what the ratio offers and pays for the rest, and each application domain has standardized the retreat its data force. The survey closes with open problems: testable diagnostics at every level, partial identification at the trajectory level, a rate theory of time-amplified error, and benchmarks with ground truth.
title_zh: 弱支撑下的轨迹密度比：一项跨学科综述
abstract_zh: 科学领域的许多问题都通过两个随机过程生成的序列来比较它们。强化学习要问：新策略在旧策略的轨迹上会获得什么回报；分子模拟要问：配体从未结合状态的样本中结合得增强多少；气候归因要问：热浪在变暖背景下发生了怎样的偏移；语言模型后训练要问：已部署智能体将根据记录的交互采取什么行动。在每种情况下，有一个量都能同时回答所有这些问题：两个概率律在其生成序列上的比值，即轨迹密度比。该比值仅在强条件下存在。当一个过程会到达另一个过程无法到达的状态时，该比值不存在；当二者的重叠很薄时，其方差会随序列长度无界增长；当它们集中于不同的低维集合时，该比值则完全无定义。这种弱支撑是序列数据的常态，而非采样偶然，其代价体现在可识别性上，而不仅仅是噪声上。本综述围绕弱支撑的三级诊断组织该领域，并绘制了当完整比值不可及时方法所采取的九种退让路径：从直接估计与重加权，到分阶段分解、平稳化与部分识别边界，再到平滑、传输耦合、算子谱以及单一泛函的直接估计。每种退让都保留了比值所提供的一部分信息，并为其余部分付出代价；每个应用领域都已将数据所迫使其采取的退让标准化。综述最后提出开放问题：每一级上可检验的诊断方法、轨迹层面的部分识别、时间放大误差的速率理论，以及具有真值的基准。

title: Constrained Variational Policy Optimization for Hybrid Action Spaces
abstract: Constrained reinforcement learning in hybrid action spaces must coordinate discrete modes and mode-conditioned continuous controls under long-horizon cost constraints. Existing constrained hybrid-action methods typically optimize factorized policies directly in parameter space, whereas Constrained Variational Policy Optimization (CVPO) separates nonparametric improvement from parametric projection in its original continuous-action formulation. We introduce Hybrid Constrained Variational Policy Optimization (H-CVPO), extending this variational framework to hybrid action spaces. Under boundedness and strict feasibility, its constrained E-step has zero duality gap and, when the dual optimum is attained at positive temperature, yields a closed-form joint target distribution over hybrid actions through exponential reward-cost reweighting. Using the exact hybrid KL decomposition, we formulate a factorized M-step that fits both policy components to this target under separate discrete and conditional-continuous trust regions. For exact E/M updates, we prove fixed-reference surrogate improvement and conditional reward-cost bounds with a sufficient feasibility-margin condition. For approximate updates, we establish the existence of a dual minimizer under continuity on a compact domain and use residual-based admissibility to determine whether to project the target. Ablations identify cost-aware reweighting as an important contributor to constraint control. Extensive experiments in simulated hybrid-control environments show that H-CVPO achieves favorable reward-cost trade-offs compared with hybrid-action baselines.
comment: 29 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. This work extends constrained variational policy optimization from continuous-action spaces to hybrid discrete-continuous action
title_zh: 混合动作空间中的约束变分策略优化
abstract_zh: 混合动作空间中的约束强化学习必须在长期成本约束下协调离散模式和以模式为条件的连续控制。现有的约束混合动作方法通常直接在参数空间中优化因子化策略，而约束变分策略优化（Constrained Variational Policy Optimization, CVPO）在其原始连续动作形式中将非参数改进与参数投影分离。我们提出混合约束变分策略优化（Hybrid Constrained Variational Policy Optimization, H-CVPO），将该变分框架扩展到混合动作空间。在有界性和严格可行性条件下，其约束 E 步具有零对偶间隙，并且当对偶最优解在正温度下取得时，通过指数式奖励—成本重加权得到混合动作上的闭式联合目标分布。利用精确的混合 KL 分解，我们构建了一个因子化 M 步，在分别的离散和条件连续信赖域下，将两个策略组件拟合到该目标。对于精确 E/M 更新，我们证明了固定参考代理改进，以及在具有充分可行性裕度条件下的条件奖励—成本界。对于近似更新，我们在紧致域上连续性的条件下确立了对偶极小值点的存在性，并使用基于残差的可接受性来判断是否投影目标。消融实验表明，成本感知重加权是约束控制的重要贡献因素。在模拟混合控制环境中的大量实验表明，与混合动作基线相比，H-CVPO 实现了有利的奖励—成本权衡。

title: Prediction with Foundation Models under Deployment Budgets
abstract: Foundation models can supply predictions for a downstream task that draw on knowledge from extensive pretraining, but they differ in task-specific accuracy and query cost. We develop a framework that improves prediction for the task under a budget on the average query cost per input, using training data to learn which models to query and how to combine their outputs with features available without querying. The first method queries the same models for every input; the second lets them vary across inputs and uses Q-learning to decide which model to query next and when to stop. For the first method, we show that several individually inaccurate outputs can jointly outperform the best single one. It attains the minimax rate when the regression function depends on the outputs only through models within the budget. Otherwise, any method within the budget can be forced to a slower rate, which the first method attains. For the second method, we show when varying the queried models across inputs strictly improves on querying the same models for every input, and bound its prediction risk and average cost in finite samples. In simulations and a multimodal laptop price application, both methods outperform existing methods.
title_zh: 部署预算下的基础模型预测
abstract_zh: 基础模型可以为下游任务提供利用广泛预训练知识的预测，但它们在任务特定准确性和查询成本上各不相同。我们开发了一个框架，在每输入平均查询成本预算下改进任务预测，利用训练数据学习查询哪些模型，以及如何将其输出与无需查询即可获得的特征相结合。第一种方法对每个输入查询相同的模型；第二种方法允许查询的模型随输入变化，并使用 Q-learning 决定接下来查询哪个模型以及何时停止。对于第一种方法，我们证明若干各自不准确的输出可以联合优于最佳单一输出。当回归函数仅通过预算内模型依赖这些输出时，该方法达到 minimax 速率。否则，任何预算内方法都可能被迫使达到更慢的速率，而第一种方法可达到该速率。对于第二种方法，我们证明何时跨输入变化查询模型会严格优于对每个输入查询相同模型，并在有限样本下界定其预测风险和平均成本。在仿真和多模态笔记本电脑价格应用中，两种方法均优于现有方法。

title: Causal discovery from Bayesian symbolic regression
abstract: Causal discovery from observational data is central to scientific reasoning, yet established constraint-based and score-based methods often recover only a Markov equivalence class and provide no signal in bivariate or strongly autocorrelated regimes typical in some areas of science. Here, we recast causal discovery as a Bayesian symbolic regression problem. Given a set of candidate parents for each target variable, the Bayesian symbolic regression samples closed-form expressions from a posterior over symbolic models. The fraction of sampled expressions in which each candidate variable appears defines a posterior inclusion probability that we use as the causal score. This replaces pointwise model selection by an ensemble of plausible mechanisms. We evaluate the method on coupled nonlinear bivariate dynamics, on the CauseMe benchmark suite spanning linear, chaotic, nonlinear, higher-dimensional and high-noise settings, and on a four-variable biogeoscience structural causal model under Gaussian, heavy-tailed and mixed-noise regimes. Our approach is competitive with, and often outperforms, specialized causal discovery algorithms. Additionally, the method returns closed-form mechanisms leading to explicit causality and interpretability.
title_zh: 基于贝叶斯符号回归的因果发现
abstract_zh: 从观测数据中进行因果发现是科学推理的核心，但既有的基于约束和基于分数的方法通常只能恢复马尔可夫等价类，并在双变量或科学某些领域中典型的强自相关情形下不提供任何信号。在这里，我们将因果发现重新表述为贝叶斯符号回归问题。给定每个目标变量的一组候选父节点，贝叶斯符号回归从符号模型的后验中采样闭式表达式。每个候选变量在采样表达式中出现的比例定义了后验纳入概率，我们将其用作因果评分。这以合理机制的集成替代了逐点模型选择。我们在耦合非线性双变量动力学、涵盖线性、混沌、非线性、高维和高噪声设置的 CauseMe 基准套件，以及高斯、重尾和混合噪声机制下的四变量生物地球科学结构因果模型上评估了该方法。我们的方法与专门的因果发现算法相比具有竞争力，且常常优于它们。此外，该方法返回闭式机制，从而实现显式因果性和可解释性。

title: UniOMA: Unified Optimal-Transport Multi-Modal Structural Alignment for Robot Perception
abstract: Achieving generalizable and well-aligned multimodal representations remains a core challenge in robot learning. While recent approaches have attempted to align modalities by modeling conditional or higher-order statistical dependencies, they do not explicitly consider the structural coherence across modalities. In this work, we propose a novel multimodal alignment method that augments existing contrastive losses with a geometry-aware Gromov--Wasserstein (GW) distance-based regularization. To this end, we encode intra-modal geometry for each modality and reduce cross-modal structural discrepancies through a dynamically learned GW barycenter, thereby encouraging structural consistency in addition to instance-level contrastive alignment. We apply this optimal-transport-based alignment strategy to robot perception tasks involving underexplored modalities such as force and tactile signals, where modality data often exhibit varying sample densities. Extensive experiments on five robotic benchmarks show that our method improves structural alignment and downstream performance over state-of-the-art multimodal contrastive baselines across a wide range of downstream tasks, including robot and environment state prediction. Moreover, our GW-based regularization can be seamlessly integrated into most InfoNCE-like objectives.
title_zh: UniOMA：用于机器人感知的统一最优传输多模态结构对齐
abstract_zh: 实现可泛化且对齐良好的多模态表示仍然是机器人学习中的核心挑战。近期方法尝试通过建模条件依赖或高阶统计依赖来对齐模态，但它们并未显式考虑跨模态的结构一致性。在这项工作中，我们提出一种新的多模态对齐方法，通过基于几何感知的 Gromov–Wasserstein（GW）距离正则项来增强现有对比损失。为此，我们编码每个模态的模态内几何，并通过动态学习的 GW 重心减少跨模态结构差异，从而在实例级对比对齐之外促进结构一致性。我们将这种基于最优传输的对齐策略应用于涉及力和触觉信号等研究较少的模态的机器人感知任务，这些模态数据通常具有不同的样本密度。在五个机器人基准上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在广泛的下游任务（包括机器人和环境状态预测）上，相比最先进的多模态对比基线，改善了结构对齐和下游性能。此外，我们的基于 GW 的正则项可以无缝集成到大多数类 InfoNCE 目标中。

title: ExoStack: A Modular and Reconfigurable Software Framework for Wearable Robotics Using ROS 2
abstract: Wearable robots depend on a software chain that links body-worn sensing to gait interpretation, assistance generation, and actuation. Personalization further requires each measured response to remain associated with the assistance parameters that generated it. This paper presents ExoStack, a modular ROS 2 framework for implementing that chain across embedded hubs and a host computer. Its Embedded Sensing and Actuation (ESA) library configures ESP32 boards as microROS sensing and actuation hubs. ExoCore supplies multi-hub synchronization, gait-event detection, profile generation, motion planning, cost evaluation, and human-in-the-loop (HIL) optimization as configuration-instantiated nodes. The PASE desktop application edits configurations, launches the processing stages, and visualizes ROS 2 topics. Hardware drivers and algorithm plugins can be added through defined interfaces without modifying the generic processing nodes. We characterize hub and planner timing on three embedded computers and demonstrate reuse on two pneumatic exosuits.
comment: The source code and accompanying documentation website for ExoStack are publicly available at and respectively
title_zh: ExoStack：基于 ROS 2 的模块化可重构可穿戴机器人软件框架
abstract_zh: 可穿戴机器人依赖一条软件链，将体戴式传感与步态解读、辅助生成及执行驱动连接起来。个性化还要求每次测得的响应都与其生成时对应的辅助参数保持关联。本文介绍 ExoStack，一个模块化的 ROS 2 框架，用于在嵌入式集线器和主机之间实现该软件链。其 Embedded Sensing and Actuation（ESA）库将 ESP32 板配置为 microROS 传感与执行集线器。ExoCore 以由配置实例化的节点形式提供多集线器同步、步态事件检测、步态轮廓生成、运动规划、代价评估和人在回路（HIL）优化。PASE 桌面应用可编辑配置、启动各处理阶段并可视化 ROS 2 话题。可以通过已定义的接口添加硬件驱动和算法插件，而无需修改通用处理节点。我们在三台嵌入式计算平台上表征了集线器和规划器的时序，并在两套气动外骨骼服上展示了复用性。

title: ECOS: Environment-Calibrated On-Policy Self-Distillation for Language Agents
abstract: On-policy self-distillation lets a language agent act as its own Teacher by conditioning on privileged context such as skills written from its own trajectories. Its guidance, however, is weighted by how much this context shifts token likelihoods rather than by whether it improves behavior, so errors in self-written skills return through later updates. We propose environment-calibrated on-policy self-distillation, which uses environmental outcomes to decide how much to trust the Teacher's current guidance and which self-written skills to reinforce. Command-level advantages, estimated by comparing commands executed at similar observations, scale each Teacher preference and reward reflections and skills whose induced preferences favor higher-advantage commands. Without skills at inference, 3B and 7B agents reach 90.5% and 93.3% macro success on seen ALFWorld tasks and 75.5% and 80.5% success on WebShop. On unseen ALFWorld tasks, they outperform GRPO under the same protocol by 11.0 and 7.6 percentage points, respectively. In an ablation study, supervising only executable commands rather than the Actor's full response raises 3B WebShop success from 52.3% to 75.0%.
title_zh: ECOS：面向语言智能体的环境校准 on-policy 自蒸馏
abstract_zh: On-policy 自蒸馏让语言智能体充当自己的 Teacher，其条件是基于特权上下文（例如根据自身轨迹写出的技能）。然而，其指导的权重取决于该上下文改变 token 似然的程度，而不是它是否改善行为，因此自写技能中的错误会通过后续更新回流。我们提出环境校准的 on-policy 自蒸馏，利用环境结果决定对 Teacher 当前指导的信任程度，以及应强化哪些自写技能。通过比较在相似观测下执行的命令来估计命令级优势，并据此缩放每个 Teacher 偏好，同时奖励那些诱导出的偏好有利于更高优势命令的反思和技能。推理时不使用技能，3B 和 7B 智能体在已见的 ALFWorld 任务上分别达到 90.5% 和 93.3% 的宏平均成功率，在 WebShop 上分别达到 75.5% 和 80.5% 的成功率。在未见的 ALFWorld 任务上，它们在同一协议下分别比 GRPO 高出 11.0 和 7.6 个百分点。在一项消融研究中，仅监督可执行命令而不是 Actor 的完整响应，使 3B 在 WebShop 上的成功率从 52.3% 提升到 75.0%。

title: TS-GEAR: Taobao Shangou GEnerative Ad Retrieval
abstract: On-demand delivery platforms such as DoorDash and Uber Eats impose a constraint absent in traditional e-commerce: merchants beyond the user's delivery range are invalid candidates rather than merely low-ranked. Generative retrieval has recently shown strong potential in large-scale retrieval systems. Adapting it to this setting, however, poses three challenges. First, existing semantic IDs encode geography only as a soft signal, so reachability can only rely on a non-differentiable post-generation hard truncation. Second, user preferences vary substantially across both regions and queries, so aggregating historical behaviors without conditioning on geography and the current query yields biased interest estimates. Third, the retrieved candidate set is evaluated by its collective value, yet autoregressive training scores each sequence independently, with no set-level signal to discourage redundant near-duplicates. To address the challenges, we propose TS-GEAR, a unified generative retrieval framework for on-demand delivery: (1) Geo-Semantic ID splits merchant identifiers into geographic prefixes and semantic suffixes, making reachability a prediction target rather than a post-hoc filter; (2) Query-Geo Target Attention aggregates historical behaviors using the real-time query and location as dual targets, while encoding each behavior's own location into its attention key; (3) GMPO (Group Marginal Policy Optimization) rewrites advantages using a deduplicated group reward and marginal advantage within GRPO, avoiding auxiliary diversity objectives. Deployed online with a lightweight 0.1B backbone, TS-GEAR serves over 150 million queries per day in the search advertising pipeline of Taobao Shangou, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art generative retrieval methods on both HitRate and geographic validity, and achieving 3.8% gains in ad impressions and 4.2% in ad revenue.
title_zh: TS-GEAR：淘宝闪购生成式广告检索
abstract_zh: DoorDash 和 Uber Eats 等即时配送平台带来了传统电商中不存在的约束：超出用户配送范围的商家是无效候选，而不仅仅是排名较低。生成式检索近来在大规模检索系统中展现出强大潜力。然而，将其适配到这一场景面临三项挑战。第一，现有语义 ID 仅将地理位置编码为软信号，因此可达性只能依赖生成后不可微的硬截断。第二，用户偏好在不同区域和查询之间差异很大，因此在聚合历史行为时不以地理位置和当前查询为条件，会产生有偏的兴趣估计。第三，检索到的候选集合按其整体价值评估，但自回归训练独立地为每个序列打分，没有集合级信号来抑制冗余的近重复项。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 TS-GEAR，一个面向即时配送的统一生成式检索框架：(1) Geo-Semantic ID 将商家标识符拆分为地理前缀和语义后缀，使可达性成为预测目标而非事后过滤器；(2) Query-Geo Target Attention 以实时查询和位置作为双重目标来聚合历史行为，同时将每个行为自身的位置编码进其注意力 key；(3) GMPO（Group Marginal Policy Optimization）在 GRPO 内利用去重后的组奖励和边际优势重写优势，避免使用辅助多样性目标。TS-GEAR 以轻量级 0.1B 骨干模型在线部署，每天在淘宝闪购的搜索广告链路中服务超过 1.5 亿次查询，在 HitRate 和地理有效性上持续优于最先进的生成式检索方法，并实现广告曝光提升 3.8%、广告收入提升 4.2%。

title: Leveraging Complementary Event Frame and Voxel Representations for RGB-Guided Multimodal Pre-training
abstract: In this paper, we propose CM3AE 2.0, a unified RGB Frame and Event-Voxel/-Frame pre-training framework. By jointly learning multimodal spatiotemporal representations and exploiting latent cross-modal dependencies through cross-modal generation, the framework enhances multimodal information interaction and collaborative modeling capabilities. Specifically, we first propose an Event-aware Spatiotemporal Masked Reconstruction (ESMR) strategy to learn unified multimodal spatiotemporal representations. It leverages event responses to guide masking toward dynamically salient regions. Through spatiotemporal masked reconstruction, it learns spatial structures and their temporal variations from continuous RGB-Event observations. In addition, it incorporates multimodal fusion reconstruction and cross-modal contrastive learning to facilitate the modeling of cross-modal complementary information and the learning of shared representations. Building upon this, we further propose a Hierarchical Cross-modal Generation (HCG) strategy to learn latent cross-modal dependencies through visual and language generation. At the visual level, Event-conditioned RGB generation is performed using a pre-trained diffusion model to capture visual associations between the two modalities. At the language level, video-level text description generation based on joint RGB-Event representations establishes connections between multimodal visual features and linguistic semantics, further enriching the learning of cross-modal dependencies. Extensive experiments on four diverse downstream tasks demonstrate that CM3AE 2.0 consistently improves performance, validating the effectiveness and generalization capability of the proposed pre-training framework.
title_zh: 利用互补的事件帧与体素表示进行 RGB 引导的多模态预训练
abstract_zh: 本文提出 CM3AE 2.0，一个统一的 RGB 帧与事件体素/事件帧预训练框架。通过联合学习多模态时空表示，并利用跨模态生成挖掘潜在的跨模态依赖关系，该框架增强了多模态信息交互和协同建模能力。具体而言，我们首先提出事件感知时空掩码重建（Event-aware Spatiotemporal Masked Reconstruction，ESMR）策略，以学习统一的多模态时空表示。它利用事件响应引导掩码聚焦到动态显著区域。通过时空掩码重建，它从连续的 RGB-事件观测中学习空间结构及其时间变化。此外，它结合多模态融合重建与跨模态对比学习，以促进跨模态互补信息的建模和共享表示的学习。在此基础上，我们进一步提出分层跨模态生成（Hierarchical Cross-modal Generation，HCG）策略，通过视觉和语言生成学习潜在的跨模态依赖关系。在视觉层面，使用预训练的扩散模型进行以事件为条件的 RGB 生成，以捕捉两种模态之间的视觉关联。在语言层面，基于 RGB-Event 联合表示生成视频级文本描述，建立多模态视觉特征与语言语义之间的联系，进一步丰富跨模态依赖关系的学习。在四个不同的下游任务上进行的大量实验表明，CM3AE 2.0 能够持续提升性能，验证了所提出预训练框架的有效性和泛化能力。

title: FireGate: Bounding Behaviour Change Before Training in Continual RL Fine-Tuning
abstract: Fine-tuning a deployed language model on one task after another can change behaviour that should stay fixed, such as earlier skills, general chat or refusals. Today, such forgetting is found only after training, on the benchmarks someone chose to run. This work bounds, before training, how often its outputs change on chosen prompt distributions. FireGate places each task's update, such as a new LoRA, behind a gate, which is a classifier on the model's frozen lower layers that decides for each prompt whether the update is used. Where no gate fires, the model computes exactly what the old one computes. As a result, on any prompt distribution, every bounded behaviour score changes by at most the gates' firing rate there over a whole task stream. Calibrating each gate on unlabeled prompts of what must not change fixes that rate before training, with a PAC guarantee, whatever weights training produces. Forgetting is thus bounded by the gate's false-alarm rate, and its price is the gate's power: no update, gated or not, that changes as few protected outputs can change new-task outputs more often than the best test of that level tells new-task prompts from protected ones. On reinforcement-learning streams of up to five tasks, gated training keeps the earlier tasks and changes 3.3% of held-out chat responses, whereas ungated training changes 91.8%. Across seven models, the gain kept behind the gate follows its firing rate on new-task prompts, measured before training. The certificate covers the gated model as deployed, on the prompt distributions sampled for calibration, not against an adversary who searches for prompts that fire the gate.
title_zh: FireGate：在持续强化学习微调中于训练前限定行为变化
abstract_zh: 依次在一个又一个任务上微调已部署的语言模型，可能会改变本应保持不变的行为，例如早期技能、通用聊天或拒答行为。目前，这类遗忘只能在训练后、在有人选择运行的基准上被发现。本文在训练前界定模型在选定提示分布上的输出变化频率上界。FireGate 将每个任务的更新（例如新的 LoRA）置于一个门控之后；该门控是建立在模型冻结低层上的分类器，用于针对每个提示决定是否使用该更新。在门控未触发的提示上，模型的计算结果与旧模型完全相同。因此，在任意提示分布上，在整个任务流中，每个有界行为评分的变化幅度至多等于各门控在该分布上的触发率。在表示“不得改变”的无标签提示上校准每个门控，可在训练前固定该触发率，并提供 PAC 保证——无论训练产生什么权重。因此，遗忘受门控误报率约束，而其代价是门控的统计功效：任何更新（无论是否带门控）若只改变极少的受保护输出，其改变新任务输出的频率就不会高于同水平下区分新任务提示与受保护提示的最佳检验所能达到的水平。在最多包含五个任务的强化学习任务流上，带门控训练保留了早期任务，并仅改变 3.3% 的留出聊天响应，而无门控训练改变了 91.8%。在七个模型上，门控后保留的增益与其在新任务提示上的触发率（训练前测得）相一致。该保证适用于部署时的带门控模型，且限于为校准而采样的提示分布，并不针对主动搜索会触发门控的提示的对手。

title: Tropical Gaussian Anticoncentration: Optimal Instance-Dependent Bounds for Online Learning in Extensive-Form Games
abstract: We study the minimax regret of full-information online decision making in extensive-form games. For prediction with expert advice, the optimal regret is Θ(T K), where K is the number of experts, or equivalently, the number of normal-form actions. For treeplex strategy spaces, existing efficient algorithms, including KOMWU and online mirror descent with the weight-one dilated entropy regularizer, achieve regret O(T|V|), where V is the set of reduced normal-form strategies. We prove that this logarithmic dependence is minimax optimal in the worst-case full-information reward model. The main difficulty is that pure plans in a treeplex are not independent experts: their rewards are correlated through the recursive structure of decisions and observations. To capture this correlation, we introduce tropical Gaussian formulae, recursive Gaussian expressions built from maxima and normalized sums which preserve the variance. The index count of such a formula matches the number of reduced normal-form continuation plans in the corresponding subtree. Our main analytic result shows that every log-balanced tropical Gaussian formula with index count N has Gaussian width Ω( N). While a direct approach struggles to recover this lower bound, our proof uses a spherical entropy profile to measure scale-dependent separation among the Gaussian directions, and then applies Turán's theorem and Sudakov minoration to obtain the width lower bound. Applying this result to treeplexes gives an oblivious hard distribution with valid transition outcome and Rademacher terminal rewards, establishing a regret lower bound of Ω(T|V|). This matches known upper bounds up to universal constants and shows that the DilEnt/KOMWU dependence on the reduced normal-form complexity is unavoidable.
title_zh: 热带高斯反集中：扩展式博弈中在线学习的最优实例相关界
abstract_zh: 我们研究扩展式博弈中全信息在线决策的极小极大遗憾。对于专家建议预测，最优遗憾为 Θ(TK)，其中 K 是专家数量，或等价地，是标准式动作的数量。对于 treeplex 策略空间，现有高效算法（包括 KOMWU 以及使用权重为 1 的膨胀熵正则项的在线镜像下降）达到 O(T|V|) 的遗憾，其中 V 是约简标准式策略的集合。我们证明，在最坏情况全信息奖励模型下，这种对数依赖是极小极大最优的。主要困难在于，treeplex 中的纯计划并非相互独立的专家：它们的奖励通过决策与观测的递归结构而相关。为刻画这种相关性，我们引入热带高斯公式，即由最大值和保持方差的归一化和构造的递归高斯表达式。此类公式的索引计数与对应子树中约简标准式后续计划的数量相匹配。我们的主要分析结果表明，每个索引计数为 N 的对数平衡热带高斯公式都具有 Ω(N) 的高斯宽度。直接方法难以恢复这一下界，而我们的证明使用球面熵轮廓来度量高斯方向之间随尺度变化的分离程度，然后应用 Turán 定理和 Sudakov 下界化得到宽度下界。将该结果应用于 treeplex 可得到一个具有有效转移结果和 Rademacher 终端奖励的 oblivious 困难分布，从而建立 Ω(T|V|) 的遗憾下界。这与已知上界在通用常数范围内相匹配，并表明 DilEnt/KOMWU 对约简标准式复杂度的依赖不可避免。

title: ACROSSVAM3.0: Resource-Bounded 4D Scene Construction and Adaptive Surface Association
abstract: Combining video generation, dynamic reconstruction and monocular SLAM requires consistent coordinates, explicit handling of missing outputs and predictable memory use. We present AcrossVAM3.0, an offline system that converts text, images or monocular RGB video into a versioned point representation. Frozen components run sequentially on one GPU; map corrections update cameras, points and trajectories together. The coordination layer adds no neural parameters. Three fresh input-mode runs completed with a maximum sampled task-process-tree GPU footprint of 17.14 GB. In a frozen 16-scene video suite, every scene yielded a 4D reconstruction and 15 yielded a non-empty SLAM map. Strict cross-window matching reduced local surface error but lost long-range track coverage on TAP-Vid-DAVIS. We therefore developed multi-hypothesis adaptive surface chaining (MHAC), which retains several candidate matches and an explicit missing state. After selection on disjoint development data, MHAC improved Average Jaccard over a position-only baseline by 0.1394 on a frozen ten-video holdout (95% bootstrap interval [0.1074,0.1689]). Across 265 RoboTAP videos, the mean paired gain was 0.0610 ([0.0510,0.0715]), with 215 wins, one tie and 49 losses. These results support resource-bounded scene construction and an external tracking gain under the tested protocol. They do not establish metric scale, semantic identity or high-fidelity novel-view rendering.
title_zh: ACROSSVAM3.0：资源受限的 4D 场景构建与自适应表面关联
abstract_zh: 将视频生成、动态重建和单目 SLAM 结合，需要一致的坐标、对缺失输出的显式处理以及可预测的内存使用。我们提出 AcrossVAM3.0，一个离线系统，可将文本、图像或单目 RGB 视频转换为版本化点表示。冻结组件在一块 GPU 上顺序运行；地图校正会同时更新相机、点和轨迹。协调层不增加任何神经参数。三次全新的输入模式运行均已完成，采样到的任务进程树最大 GPU 占用为 17.14 GB。在一个冻结的 16 场景视频套件中，每个场景都生成了 4D 重建，其中 15 个生成了非空 SLAM 地图。严格的跨窗口匹配降低了局部表面误差，但在 TAP-Vid-DAVIS 上损失了长程轨迹覆盖。因此，我们开发了多假设自适应表面链接（multi-hypothesis adaptive surface chaining，MHAC），它保留多个候选匹配和一个显式缺失状态。在不相交的开发数据上完成选择后，MHAC 在一个冻结的十视频留出集上，将 Average Jaccard 相对于仅位置基线提高了 0.1394（95% bootstrap 区间 [0.1074,0.1689]）。在 265 个 RoboTAP 视频上，平均配对增益为 0.0610（[0.0510,0.0715]），其中 215 胜、1 平、49 负。这些结果支持在测试协议下实现资源受限的场景构建和外部跟踪增益。它们并未确立度量尺度、语义身份或高保真新视角渲染。

title: Creative Priming: Decoupling Process from Product to Escape the Creative Paradox
abstract: Many of the most consequential advances promised by AI, from curing diseases and inventing new technologies to formulating new scientific theories, are fundamentally creative acts. Yet creativity is uniquely difficult to learn because it faces a creative paradox: learning to repeat past examples of creative success makes those specific examples more likely to recur, inhibiting the very creativity desired. This work argues that creativity is better modeled as an explicit process rather than as a property of individual artifacts, and proposes to learn the underlying generative principles behind the creative process. In particular, to escape the paradox, we introduce creative priming (CP), wherein a trained priming model generates a prompt-specific primer that assists a response model in being creative, explicitly decoupling the creative process from response generation. The priming model learns through GRPO, rewarding primers that lead to responses that are novel, high-quality, and diverse, thereby reinforcing the process that yields creative responses without reinforcing any specific response.
title_zh: Creative Priming：将过程与产物解耦，以摆脱创造力悖论
abstract_zh: AI 所承诺的许多最具深远意义的进步——从治愈疾病、发明新技术到提出新的科学理论——本质上都是创造性行为。然而，创造力异常难以学习，因为它面临一个创造力悖论：学习重复过去的创造性成功范例，会使这些具体范例更有可能再次出现，从而抑制了人们所期望的创造力。这项工作主张，将创造力更好地建模为一个显式过程，而不是单个产物的属性，并提出学习创造性过程背后的生成原理。特别地，为逃离这一悖论，我们引入创意启动（creative priming，CP）：由经过训练的启动模型（priming model）生成针对特定提示（prompt）的引子（primer），协助响应模型（response model）进行创造，从而将创造性过程与响应生成显式解耦。启动模型通过 GRPO 学习，奖励那些能带来新颖、高质量且多样化响应的引子，从而强化产生创造性响应的过程，而不强化任何具体响应。

title: Scalable Counterfactual Explanations for Time Series via Policy Learning
abstract: Generating counterfactual (CF) explanations for time series is challenging due to complex temporal dependencies and the computational inefficiency of traditional instance-specific optimization. We propose a policy learning framework for counterfactual explanation in time series, trained as a one-step contextual-bandit policy-learning problem. By training an actor-critic agent in the latent space of a pre-trained autoencoder, our method learns a transferable policy that captures global structural regularities. Unlike existing methods that rely on iterative optimization for each new input, the learned policy enables direct generation of valid and plausible counterfactuals through a single forward pass, avoiding per-instance optimization at inference time. Experiments on 13 UCR benchmark datasets show that our framework achieves high validity and strong plausibility across multiple anomaly detection metrics. Overall, by decoupling counterfactual generation from per-instance optimization, the proposed method provides an efficient and scalable alternative to existing approaches for time series counterfactual explanations.
title_zh: 通过策略学习实现时间序列的可扩展反事实解释
abstract_zh: 为时间序列生成反事实（CF）解释具有挑战性，原因在于复杂的时间依赖关系以及传统实例特定优化的计算低效。我们提出一种用于时间序列反事实解释的策略学习框架，将其训练为一步式上下文赌博机策略学习问题。通过在预训练自编码器的潜在空间中训练 actor-critic 智能体，我们的方法学习到一种可迁移策略，能够捕捉全局结构规律。与依赖对每个新输入进行迭代优化的现有方法不同，学习到的策略可通过单次前向传播直接生成有效且合理的反事实，从而在推理时避免逐实例优化。在 13 个 UCR 基准数据集上的实验表明，我们的框架在多种异常检测指标上实现了高有效性和强合理性。总体而言，通过将反事实生成与逐实例优化解耦，所提方法为时间序列反事实解释提供了一种高效且可扩展的替代方案。

title: A Sequential Monte Carlo Method for Data Assimilation in Subsurface Flow Systems with Hierarchical Uncertainty
abstract: Subsurface flow systems often involve hierarchical geological uncertainty, meaning both higher-level metaparameters and cell-by-cell properties are uncertain. This leads to challenges for data assimilation because both sets of parameters must be estimated. In this work we develop an adaptive-tempered sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) procedure for joint Bayesian estimation of these quantities. The method uses noncentered geological parameterizations, with geomodel realizations represented by metaparameters and Gaussian latent variables that are independent under the prior. Adaptive likelihood tempering, importance weighting, resampling, and blockwise Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) mutation are applied at each iteration. Flow surrogates are used for all function evaluations. The hierarchical SMC procedure is further extended to treat successive data assimilation. In this case, existing posterior particles are updated in a manner that accounts for correlations in surrogate model errors across observation batches. We consider two distinct 3D systems with hierarchical uncertainty. The first is a faulted carbon storage system containing three stacked aquifers and two extensive faults. Principal component analysis is used to represent target-aquifer heterogeneity, while geological metaparameters characterize uncertain aquifer and fault properties. The second is a channelized oil-water system containing three facies with uncertain properties. A latent diffusion model represents variability in channel geometry and facies realizations. For the four synthetic true models considered, SMC posterior metaparameter distributions and flow predictions agree closely with reference MCMC results. SMC, however, requires fewer function evaluations and provides speedups of 2.5--7.0 for single-stage data assimilation. Even greater speedups are achieved with multiple GPUs.
title_zh: 一种用于具有层级不确定性的地下流动系统数据同化的序列蒙特卡洛方法
abstract_zh: 地下流动系统通常涉及层级地质不确定性，即高层元参数和逐单元属性均不确定。这给数据同化带来挑战，因为两组参数都必须估计。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种自适应退火序列蒙特卡洛（SMC）方法，用于对这些量进行联合贝叶斯估计。该方法采用非中心化地质参数化，其中地质模型实现由元参数和高斯潜变量表示，且这些变量在先验下相互独立。在每次迭代中，应用自适应似然退火、重要性加权、重采样和分块马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）变异。所有函数评估均使用流动代理模型。该层级 SMC 过程进一步扩展到处理连续数据同化。在这种情况下，现有后验粒子会以考虑跨观测批次的代理模型误差相关性的方式进行更新。我们考虑了两个具有层级不确定性的不同 3D 系统。第一个是含断层碳封存系统，包含三个叠置含水层和两条大型断层。主成分分析用于表示目标含水层的非均质性，而地质元参数则表征不确定的含水层和断层属性。第二个是河道化油水系统，包含三种具有不确定属性的相。潜扩散模型表示河道几何形态和相实现的变异性。对于所考虑的四组合成真实模型，SMC 后验元参数分布和流动预测与参考 MCMC 结果高度一致。然而，SMC 所需的函数评估更少，在单阶段数据同化中提供 2.5–7.0 倍的加速。使用多个 GPU 时可实现更大的加速。

title: Qubit-to-Motion: Traceable Action Provenance in Hybrid QRL for Robotic Bin-Packing Sequencing
abstract: Hybrid quantum reinforcement learning has been explored for robotic decision-making, but evaluations often emphasize task success, return, or convergence, leaving unresolved whether quantum circuit outputs influence constrained actions and remain traceable through robot execution. We present Qubit-to-Motion, an evidence-centered framework for support-constrained sequencing and simulated robotic placement. Four Pauli-Z readouts provide the sole learned input to the actor and critic, while a support mask enforces admissible object selection. Each decision is recorded and linked via step indices and SHA-256 fingerprints to a sealed route, deterministic Cartesian and inverse-kinematics waypoints, prescribed joint motion, and MuJoCo contact replay. A frozen checkpoint is evaluated across five deterministic 30-object scene variants. All 150 placements satisfy support, containment, and settling criteria. A fixed-state zero-readout intervention changes 90.00.0\% of decisions, demonstrating dependence on the joint circuit representation. Mean macro travel is 34.5370.206 m, inference requires 8.601.27 ms per route, and replay achieves 8.7640.220 μm mean final position error with 0.356 mm maximum interpenetration. These results establish reproducible decision-to-contact traceability. The implementation is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Qubit-to-Motion-Quantum-Reinforcement-Learning-F7DClinkpinkthe anonymous repository.
title_zh: Qubit-to-Motion：混合 QRL 中用于机器人装箱排序的可追溯动作来源
abstract_zh: 混合量子强化学习已被探索用于机器人决策，但评估往往侧重于任务成功率、回报或收敛性，尚未解决量子电路输出是否影响受约束动作、以及能否在机器人执行过程中保持可追溯的问题。我们提出 Qubit-to-Motion，一个以证据为中心的框架，用于支持约束下的排序和仿真机器人放置。四个 Pauli-Z 读出构成 actor 和 critic 唯一的学习输入，同时支持掩码（support mask）强制选择允许的物体。每个决策都被记录，并通过步骤索引和 SHA-256 指纹关联到密封路线、确定性的笛卡尔和逆运动学路点、规定的关节运动以及 MuJoCo 接触回放。冻结的检查点在五个确定性的 30 物体场景变体上进行评估。全部 150 次放置均满足支撑、容纳和稳定标准。固定状态零读出干预改变了 90.0±0.0% 的决策，表明决策依赖于联合电路表示。平均宏观移动距离为 34.537±0.206 m，每条路线的推理耗时为 8.60±1.27 ms，回放实现 8.764±0.220 μm 的平均最终位置误差，最大相互穿透为 0.356 mm。这些结果确立了可复现的从决策到接触的可追溯性。实现可在以下匿名仓库获取：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Qubit-to-Motion-Quantum-Reinforcement-Learning-F7DC

title: InfCoiL: Coordinated Planner-Controller Learning for Closed-Loop Physics-Based Human-Object Interaction
abstract: Text- and goal-conditioned human-object interaction (HOI) provides an intuitive interface for specifying high-level intents in physics-based character animation. Mapping such intents to physically plausible, contact-rich behaviors naturally calls for a generative planner and a physics-based controller, yet existing planner-controller systems either execute plans open-loop or close the loop while keeping the planner fixed, so execution feedback never reshapes what is planned. We present InfCoiL, a closed-loop framework for physics-based HOI from coordinated planner-controller learning. InfCoiL couples a morphology-aware flow-matching planner with a unified multi-morphology controller through a shared morphology interface in an autoregressive plan-and-execute loop, and alternately fine-tunes both components with reinforcement learning from the same physical rollouts. To optimize the flow-matching planner online, we introduce Semantic Flow Policy Optimization (SFPO), which stochasticizes selected denoising transitions with channel-wise semantic covariance over heterogeneous HOI features and assigns group-relative, sequence-level rewards from complete closed-loop executions. On held-out OMOMO sequences, InfCoiL outperforms open-loop hierarchical baselines in goal-reaching task success and physical tracking accuracy. Project page: https://infcoil.github.io/
title_zh: InfCoiL：面向闭环、基于物理的人-物交互的协同规划器-控制器学习
abstract_zh: 文本和目标条件化的人-物交互（HOI）为在基于物理的角色动画中指定高层意图提供了直观接口。将此类意图映射为物理上合理、接触丰富的动作，自然需要生成式规划器和基于物理的控制器，但现有的规划器-控制器系统要么以开环方式执行计划，要么在闭环时保持规划器固定，因此执行反馈从未重塑规划内容。我们提出 InfCoiL，一个通过协同规划器-控制器学习实现基于物理 HOI 的闭环框架。InfCoiL 通过共享的形态接口，将形态感知的 flow-matching 规划器与统一的多形态控制器耦合在自回归的“规划-执行”循环中，并利用来自同一物理 rollout 的强化学习交替微调两个组件。为了在线优化 flow-matching 规划器，我们引入 Semantic Flow Policy Optimization（SFPO），它利用异构 HOI 特征上的通道级语义协方差，对选定的去噪转移进行随机化，并根据完整闭环执行结果分配组相对、序列级奖励。在留出的 OMOMO 序列上，InfCoiL 在目标达成任务成功率和物理跟踪精度方面优于开环分层基线。项目页面：https://infcoil.github.io/

title: TransArt3D: From Two States to Articulated 3D Reconstruction with Video Transition Priors
abstract: Reconstructing interactable articulated assets from a few images is key to robotics and simulation, yet highly underconstrained. Existing optimization-based methods fit an articulated asset under a static 3D prior that scores each state independently, so per-state reconstruction errors leak into the estimated moving part and joint as false motion. Video diffusion models capture how objects move between states, but only implicitly in 2D. To this end, we present TransArt3D, an optimization-based framework that reconstructs an articulated 3D asset from two endpoint images by translating this video transition prior into explicit part structure and joint kinematics. It first lifts frames generated between the endpoints with a transition-coupled 3D consensus that applies the static 3D prior jointly across frames, stabilizing unchanging regions and initializing the parts and joint. A rectified-flow kinematic refinement then lets the video prior supervise a 3D motion field over the whole transition, while part assignment and a shared joint constrain the field throughout optimization, keeping per-state errors out of the articulation. Finally, a motion-aware canonical appearance fusion uses the recovered articulation to map both endpoint images onto one canonical surface, texturing regions that only one state reveals. On PartNet-Mobility, TransArt3D outperforms methods given the same two endpoints in geometry and joint accuracy, and surpasses methods given six observed states in articulated-state geometry, joint localization and appearance.
title_zh: TransArt3D：从两个状态出发，借助视频过渡先验进行铰接式 3D 重建
abstract_zh: 从少量图像重建可交互的铰接式资产是机器人和仿真的关键，但该问题高度欠约束。现有基于优化的方法在静态 3D 先验下拟合铰接式资产，而该先验独立地对每个状态评分，因此逐状态重建误差会泄漏到估计的运动部件和关节中，形成虚假运动。视频扩散模型能够捕捉物体在状态之间的运动，但仅在 2D 中隐式地捕捉。为此，我们提出 TransArt3D，一个基于优化的框架，通过将这种视频过渡先验转化为显式的部件结构和关节运动学，从两幅端点图像重建铰接式 3D 资产。它首先利用过渡耦合的 3D 一致性提升端点之间生成的帧，该一致性跨帧联合应用静态 3D 先验，从而稳定不变区域并初始化部件和关节。随后，rectified-flow 运动学细化让视频先验监督整个过渡过程中的 3D 运动场，同时在优化过程中通过部件分配和共享关节约束该运动场，将逐状态误差排除在铰接结构之外。最后，运动感知的规范外观融合利用恢复出的铰接结构，将两幅端点图像映射到同一规范表面，并为仅由一个状态揭示的区域进行纹理化。在 PartNet-Mobility 上，TransArt3D 在几何和关节精度方面优于使用相同两幅端点图像的方法，并在铰接状态几何、关节定位和外观方面超过了使用六个观测状态的方法。

title: GenISys: Integrated Ship Systems Design Using Subsystem-Conditional Tabular Diffussion
abstract: Ship design requires coordinating coupled subsystems to satisfy engineering constraints and balance competing performance and cost objectives. Generative artificial intelligence has supported component design, but integrated ship generation must also account for interactions among hull geometry, structure, propulsion, and operation. This paper presents GenISys, a framework for generating integrated systems, demonstrated through early-stage bulk-carrier design. Its dataset contains 217,999 proposed designs, including 16,247 that satisfy the formulated engineering constraints. The proposed simultaneous conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (SCDDPM) generates subsystems together, allowing each subsystem model to respond to changes elsewhere during generation. Experiments compare this approach with monolithic whole-ship generation and sequential subsystem generation across five independent training runs per architecture. In a study targeting lower cost per tonne of cargo transported, designs were generated for a required voyage range of 5,000 nautical miles. SCDDPM produced designs satisfying the formulated engineering constraints and meeting a common low-cost target in 55.70% of generation requests, compared with 51.10% for the monolithic model and 47.54% for the sequential model. These correspond to 9.0% and 17.2% more qualifying designs, respectively, while maintaining similar estimated transport costs. These results show how generative artificial intelligence can coordinate subsystems to generate feasible, high-performing integrated systems.
title_zh: GenISys：使用子系统条件表格扩散的集成船舶系统设计
abstract_zh: 船舶设计要求协调相互耦合的子系统，以满足工程约束并平衡相互竞争的性能与成本目标。生成式人工智能已支持部件设计，但集成船舶生成还必须考虑船体几何、结构、推进和运行之间的相互作用。本文提出 GenISys，一个用于生成集成系统的框架，并以早期散货船设计为例进行演示。其数据集包含 217,999 个候选设计方案，其中 16,247 个满足所制定的工程约束。所提出的同时条件去噪扩散概率模型（SCDDPM）联合生成各子系统，使每个子系统模型都能在生成过程中响应其他子系统的变化。实验在每种架构五次独立训练运行中，将该方法与整体式全船生成和顺序式子系统生成进行比较。在一项以降低单位货物运输成本为目标的研究中，针对 5,000 海里的所需航程生成设计方案。SCDDPM 在 55.70% 的生成请求中产生了满足所制定工程约束并达到共同低成本目标的设计，而整体式模型和顺序式模型分别为 51.10% 和 47.54%。这分别对应多出 9.0% 和 17.2% 的合格设计，同时估计运输成本相近。这些结果表明，生成式人工智能如何协调各子系统，以生成可行且高性能的集成系统。

title: NightSteps: A Night-Time Dataset and Benchmark for Pedestrian Crossing Intention Prediction
abstract: Autonomous vehicles use pedestrian crossing intention prediction (PCIP) to participate safely in traffic. Existing models are largely trained under favourable daytime conditions with sufficient daylight. Little is known about the robustness of these models under night-time and low-light conditions, due to the lack of datasets containing night-time footage. This paper investigates how a dataset, named NightSteps, can be constructed and evaluated as a baseline benchmark. The dataset is based on nighttime dashcam footage collected from six different cities around the world, capturing a wide variety of road conditions. The dataset consists of dashcam-recorded point-of-view footage, raw data of pedestrians' locations with corresponding 'track ids' and ground-truth labels containing accurate information about pedestrian crossing behaviour, resulting in a diverse dataset. Gemini, ChatGPT, and human assessment are used to demonstrate the usability of the dataset by predicting crossings in clips from the dataset and comparing the results with the initial ground-truth labels. These results show that human input achieves an accuracy of 88.17% and an F1-score of 80.21%. Predictions from Gemini and ChatGPT perform lower, with accuracies of 60% and 79.13% respectively, and F1-scores of 42.50% and 63.64%. The evaluation demonstrates that the NightSteps dataset can be used for future model evaluation to test the performance of PCIP, with the aim of improving road safety at night.
title_zh: NightSteps：夜间行人过街意图预测数据集与基准
abstract_zh: 自动驾驶汽车利用行人过街意图预测（PCIP）来安全地参与交通。现有模型大多在光照充足的有利白天条件下训练。由于缺乏包含夜间影像的数据集，人们对这些模型在夜间和低光照条件下的鲁棒性知之甚少。本文研究如何构建一个名为 NightSteps 的数据集，并将其作为基线基准进行评估。该数据集基于从全球六个不同城市采集的夜间行车记录仪影像，涵盖多种道路条件。数据集由行车记录仪视角影像、带有对应“track id”的行人位置原始数据，以及包含行人过街行为准确信息的地面真值标签组成，从而形成多样化数据集。研究使用 Gemini、ChatGPT 和人工评估，通过预测数据集片段中的过街行为并将结果与初始地面真值标签比较，来证明该数据集的可用性。这些结果表明，人工输入的准确率达到 88.17%，F1 分数为 80.21%。Gemini 和 ChatGPT 的预测表现较低，准确率分别为 60% 和 79.13%，F1 分数分别为 42.50% 和 63.64%。该评估表明，NightSteps 数据集可用于未来的模型评估，以测试 PCIP 的性能，目标是提高夜间道路安全性。

title: When Coding Agents Get Arms: Safety Risks Across the Digital-Physical Boundary
abstract: Advances in spatial understanding have enabled frontier models to power coding agents that control a real robot arm zero-shot and end-to-end, without task-specific demonstrations or retraining. This brings two new safety challenges. First, the extensive knowledge of frontier models lets these agents perform tasks that earlier VLA and WAM paradigms could not, opening the door to new forms of capability misuse. Second, coding agents can access digital resources such as web pages and emails. Threats in these resources, such as indirect prompt injection, can carry over into the physical world when the agent controls a robot. We therefore introduce ArmedAgent, the first systematic benchmark to evaluate both risks for coding agents performing zero-shot robot control. It covers robustness, malicious use, and indirect injection across 36 tasks in 5 scenarios, evaluated in simulation and validated on a physical robot arm. A distinctive portion of the tasks target harmful behaviors that earlier VLA paradigms could not perform. Testing several frontier models, including GPT-6-Astra, under widely used agent frameworks, we find substantial safety risks in current systems.
title_zh: 当 Coding Agents 获得机械臂：跨越数字—物理边界的安全风险
abstract_zh: 空间理解领域的进展使前沿模型能够驱动 coding agents，以 zero-shot、end-to-end 的方式控制真实机械臂，无需任务特定演示或重新训练。这带来了两项新的安全挑战。首先，前沿模型拥有的广泛知识使这些智能体能够执行此前的 VLA 和 WAM 范式无法完成的任务，从而为新的能力滥用形式打开了大门。其次，coding agents 可以访问网页和电子邮件等数字资源。这些资源中的威胁（例如 indirect prompt injection）可能在智能体控制机器人时传导至物理世界。因此，我们提出 ArmedAgent，这是首个系统评估 coding agents 执行 zero-shot 机器人控制时上述两类风险的基准。它涵盖 5 个场景中的 36 个任务，涉及鲁棒性、恶意使用和间接注入，并在仿真中评估、在真实机械臂上验证。其中一部分独特任务针对此前的 VLA 范式无法执行的有害行为。我们在广泛使用的智能体框架下测试了包括 GPT-6-Astra 在内的多个前沿模型，发现当前系统存在显著安全风险。

title: Computationally Efficient Offline Policy Optimization with All-Policy Linear Realizability
abstract: We study offline policy optimization in finite-horizon Markov decision processes where every deterministic Markov policy has an action-value function linear in known features, with coefficient norm at most B. From independent complete trajectories of one unknown Markov behavior policy, and under all-policy occupancy coverage, we give an algorithm with O(^-2) sample dependence and computational complexity polynomial in (2+B). The algorithm performs exactly one convex regression per layer. Its stopped-return targets are the values of a single consistent Markov witness policy. A shared reference design and bounded prediction constraints convert fast clipped-regression error into pointwise confidence for the raw linear predictions. Truncated leverage controls the performance loss without requiring empirical covariance approximation at scale B^-2. Rounding confidence radii upward preserves the exact witness and yields a polynomial-time bit implementation for rational numerical inputs. The guarantees allow any fixed initial-state distribution; realizability and coverage need only be checked for deterministic policies. We also establish a covariance-coverage variant with uniform approximate realizability and polynomial dependence on B. A two-action lower bound shows that the accuracy exponent 2 is necessary.
title_zh: 具有全策略线性可实现性的计算高效离线策略优化
abstract_zh: 我们研究有限时域马尔可夫决策过程中的离线策略优化：每个确定性马尔可夫策略的动作价值函数都关于已知特征线性，且系数范数至多为 B。基于来自某一未知马尔可夫行为策略的独立完整轨迹，并在全策略占用覆盖条件下，我们给出一种样本依赖性为 O(^-2)、计算复杂度关于 (2+B) 为多项式的算法。该算法在每一层恰好执行一次凸回归。其 stopped-return 目标是一个单一且一致的马尔可夫见证策略的值。共享参考设计与有界预测约束将快速的 clipped-regression 误差转化为原始线性预测的逐点置信度。截断杠杆值可在无需于 B^-2 规模下进行经验协方差近似的情况下控制性能损失。将置信半径向上取整可保持精确见证，并为有理数数值输入给出多项式时间的位级实现。所获保证允许任意固定的初始状态分布；可实现性与覆盖性只需针对确定性策略检查。我们还建立了一个协方差覆盖变体，其具有一致近似可实现性，并对 B 呈多项式依赖。一个双动作下界表明，精度指数 2 是必要的。

title: Conditional Diffusion-Based Proxy Representation Recovery for BCVA Prediction with Missing SLO Modality
abstract: Preoperative prediction of postoperative best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) can support prognosis assessment and individualized decision-making in cataract surgery. Multimodal learning can integrate preoperative optical coherence tomography (OCT) images, scanning laser ophthalmoscopy (SLO) images, and clinical text to characterize patient status. However, SLO images are often missing in real-world clinical data due to acquisition or data-management issues, resulting in incomplete multimodal inputs. To address this problem, this paper proposes a conditional diffusion-based method for SLO proxy representation recovery and fusion prediction. Instead of reconstructing raw SLO images, the proposed method formulates SLO missingness as proxy representation recovery in the latent feature space. Specifically, OCT image features and clinical text features are first fused to construct an OCT-text conditional representation, which guides the reverse denoising process of the diffusion model to estimate sample-specific SLO proxy representations. The recovered SLO proxy representation is then used as a substitute for the unavailable SLO modality and incorporated into the downstream multimodal fusion prediction network for postoperative BCVA prediction. Experiments were conducted on 2,141 preoperative multimodal cataract samples, with an SLO missing rate of 58.80%. The proposed method achieved an accuracy of 0.9714 under the criterion of an absolute prediction error within 0.1 LogMAR and a mean absolute error of 0.0423, outperforming representative postoperative visual acuity prediction and missing-modality learning methods. These results indicate that representation-level proxy recovery can alleviate the impact of SLO modality missingness on postoperative BCVA prediction.
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at IEEE BIBM 2026
title_zh: 面向 SLO 模态缺失的 BCVA 预测：基于条件扩散的代理表征恢复
abstract_zh: 术前预测术后最佳矫正视力（BCVA）可为白内障手术的预后评估和个体化决策提供支持。多模态学习能够整合术前光学相干断层扫描（OCT）图像、扫描激光检眼镜（SLO）图像和临床文本，以刻画患者状态。然而，在真实临床数据中，由于采集或数据管理问题，SLO 图像常常缺失，导致多模态输入不完整。为解决这一问题，本文提出一种基于条件扩散的 SLO 代理表征恢复与融合预测方法。该方法并不重建原始 SLO 图像，而是将 SLO 缺失问题建模为潜在特征空间中的代理表征恢复。具体而言，首先融合 OCT 图像特征和临床文本特征以构建 OCT-文本条件表征，该表征引导扩散模型的逆向去噪过程，以估计样本特异的 SLO 代理表征。随后，将恢复的 SLO 代理表征作为不可用 SLO 模态的替代，纳入下游多模态融合预测网络，用于术后 BCVA 预测。实验在 2,141 个术前多模态白内障样本上进行，SLO 缺失率为 58.80%。在绝对预测误差不超过 0.1 LogMAR 的准则下，所提方法达到 0.9714 的准确率，平均绝对误差为 0.0423，优于具有代表性的术后视力预测方法和缺失模态学习方法。这些结果表明，表征级代理恢复能够缓解 SLO 模态缺失对术后 BCVA 预测的影响。
